jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Support Manager

__

To strengthen our engineering team, we are looking for a dedicated, experienced Project Engineer. In this role, you take responsibility as a technical authority for electrical engineering projects with low to medium complexity – particularly for medium-voltage, low-voltage and standby power systems in the service business (retrofit). You implement the requirements of concepts within the specified time and budget framework and ensure that all specifications, quality standards, safety requirements and standards are consistently met.


Work Model: #hybrid
Business Line: Service (Division Electrification)

Your responsibilities

  • Product configuration, creation of electrical schematics using EPLAN and preparation of simple mechanical drawings using AutoCAD

  • Creation of selectivity calculations

  • Execution of type testing (design verifications) for non-standard configurations based on checklists and applicable standards

  • Technical support during tests and commissioning and support of project management in technical reviews, customer meetings and implementation of change and variation requests

  • Development of effort estimates and feasibility recommendations for the quotation team

  • Preparation of system documentation, as-built documents and acceptance records

• Qualifications for the Role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an electrician or automation technician plus further training as a technician HF/FH or comparable qualification

  • At least 2 years of professional experience in project engineering, ideally in energy technology. Experience in mechanical engineering is an advantage.

  • Very good CAD skills in EPLAN Electric P8; AutoCAD skills are an advantage

  • Technical understanding of the engineering of power supply systems (MV/LV/emergency supply power), ideally with experience with low-voltage switchgear

  • Strong focus on safe working practices and commitment to compliance with all relevant safety guidelines

  • Very high self-motivation as well as independent, solution-oriented and responsible working methods

  • Team player with a cooperative approach and good communication skills; you are fluent in German and English – French language skills are an advantage

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Department Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Conducting applied research in the area of power device physics with focus on dielectric insulation, breakdown phenomena, and other multi-physics topics

  • Contributing to and leading research projects towards sustainable solutions for the upcoming energy transformation, integration of renewable energies and energy storage systems

  • Applying commercial and in-house developed advanced simulation tools

  • Planning, setting up, and executing scientific experiments

  • Driving research activities, generating intellectual property, and writing scientific publications

  • Closely cooperating with scientists and engineers within the team, driving collaborations within the research center, with universities, and global ABB divisions

In this role, as a member of the Power Device Physics team, within Energy Technologies department, you work on the broad portfolio of ABB devices and systems from longer-term fundamental research up to time-critical questions in products. You provide novel and innovative solutions in the field of dielectric insulation in gases and solids with overlap to other multi-physical topics. Translating your findings from basic research on physical phenomena to prototypes demonstrating the technologies, you contribute to evolving applications in such fields as protection systems for sustainable energy generation and distribution. To achieve this, you utilize state-of-the-art simulations, perform scientific experiments, and apply the results to technology development and expert support of ABBs business divisions.


Reporting to the research team manager, you will engage with cross-functional teams inside and outside the company, contribute to the definition of the team research roadmap, and to the management of the research projects.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in physics or electrical engineering, background in dielectric is a plus (please submit a list of publications if available).

  • Hands-on experience in a scientific or industrial laboratory, a willingness to work independently and take initiatives in designing, building, and testing prototypes

  • Experience in simulations, e.g., COMSOL

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach with good ability to build and maintain work relationships

  • Strong communication and presentation skills in English (both written and spoken)

​More about us

The Power Device Physics Team at the ABB research center in Switzerland conducts interdisciplinary research focusing on multi-physical phenomena related to the broad portfolio of ABB's devices and systems, including switchgear and power electronics. The team consists of enthusiastic scientists and engineers whose activities span from deepening the knowledge of physical phenomena such as dielectric breakdowns in gases/solids/vacuum, or thermal management with novel cooling concepts, to solving questions directly related to ABB's product portfolio. Our expertise and solutions are used to enable and support the development of next-generation products. This unique opportunity allows you to carry out research in an evolving field and to contribute with your expertise to ABB’s success by reinforcing our team. If you are passionate about science and technology and want to work in an inspiring environment where your skills and ideas become part of solutions for a sustainable future, then apply now.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Operations Manager

__

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

As part of our strategic growth agenda, we are hiring a new Global Head of Quality for our Motion Traction Division.

This role is open globally, and preferred locations are set close to our main Motion Traction locations in Switzerland, Germany, Italy, and Poland.

The work model is hybrid and regular presence in our factories and suppliers' location will be expected, with the ability to travel up to 30% of the time.

#LIhybrid

To support the continued growth of our Motion Traction business and the increasing expectations of our customers, we are looking for a Global Head of Quality who will elevate quality into a true source of competitive advantage across our global organization.

This is a high-impact leadership role for a technical quality leader who wants to shape the future of quality in a complex, engineered-to-order environment. Beyond defining strategy, you will be expected to build a lasting quality culture, one that is owned by every function, every site, and every team involved in delivering reliable, high-performance solutions to our customers.

As a member of the divisional leadership team, you will lead a global network of quality professionals and act as a key connector across Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, R&D, Project Execution, and Customer-facing teams. You will bring people together around a shared ambition: preventing issues before they occur, solving problems at the root cause, and continuously raising the standard of performance across the full value chain.

This role calls for a leader who combines strong technical credibility with the ability to influence, engage, and mobilize people in a global matrix organization. You will need to move confidently between strategic transformation and operational detail, from quality governance, supplier performance, and closed-loop quality systems to shopfloor engagement, customer feedback, and data-based decision making.

Success in this role will depend on your ability to create ownership rather than control. You will empower teams to identify risks early, strengthen prevention over detection, and embed accountability for quality into everyday decisions. By doing so, you will help build a culture where quality is not a department or a process, but a mindset that enables customer trust, operational excellence, and sustainable growth.

For a technical leader who is motivated by impact, complexity, and global collaboration, this is an opportunity to shape quality at scale, driving measurable improvement today while building the capabilities, systems, and culture that will define the future of Motion Traction.

Key • Responsibilities

  • Set and execute the global quality strategy in line with business priorities, ABB quality standards, and QMS requirements.

  • Lead the global Quality organization and strengthen a consistent, prevention-focused quality culture across regions.

  • Build and sustain a robust closed-loop quality process from product development through customer feedback.

  • Drive global standards for supplier quality, production quality assurance, testing, and outgoing inspection.

  • Lead data-driven quality governance, including analytics, risk identification, non-conformance management, and prevention initiatives.

  • Partner with Engineering, R&D, Operations, Supply Chain, and Customer teams to resolve issues systematically, prevent recurrence, and improve quality performance.

  • Oversee global quality processes, audits, governance models, and continuous improvement frameworks.

  • Embed quality early in product and process development through structured planning, APQP/PPAP where applicable, and proactive risk detection.

• Qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience in Quality, Engineering, or Operations within complex industrial or engineered-to-order environments.

  • Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial Engineering, or a related technical field; equivalent technical experience will also be considered.

  • Proven record of driving quality improvement, leading structured problem solving, and using data to improve business performance.

  • Strong expertise in quality systems, QMS governance, root cause analysis, 8D, and Lean, ideally gained in automotive, rail, or heavy equipment environments; APQP, PPAP, DFMEA, and PFMEA knowledge is a strong advantage.

  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional teams and influence stakeholders in a global matrix organization.

  • Familiarity with IRIS, EN/IEC standards, and regulatory requirements related to traction or railway applications is an advantage.

  • Proven experience leading teams, developing (seasoned) people, and creating a positive, collaborative environment that supports engagement, accountability, and high performance.

  • Excellent communication skills with fluency in English

  • Willingness to travel up to 30% globally.

#ABBCareers

#RunwithABB

#Runwhatrunstheworld

This opportunity is open to candidates in multiple countries, with the final work location determined based on the selected candidate. As compensation may vary by location, we are committed to being transparent throughout the hiring process and will share details of the salary range, variable compensation and benefits package with candidates who progress to the first interview stage for a location in the European Union, covered by the EU Pay Transparency Directive.

The final offer will be tailored based on your role, location, experience, skills and qualifications, internal market positioning and alignment with ABB internal standards.


ABB Motion, a global leader in motors and drives, is at the core of accelerating a more productive and sustainable future. We innovate and push the boundaries of technology to contribute to energy efficient, decarbonizing, and circular solutions for customers, industries, and societies. With our digitally enabled drives, motors and services we support our customers and partners to achieve better performance, safety and reliability. To help the world’s industries outrun – leaner and cleaner, we deliver motor-driven solutions for a wide range of applications in all industrial segments. Building on over 140 years of domain expertise in electric powertrains, our more than 22,000 employees across 100 countries learn and improve every day. go.abb/motion

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit careers.abb to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences

Ce poste relève de :

Global Operations Manager

ABB Traction Division est un leader reconnu dans les technologies de propulsion à bord qui stimulent l'innovation dans l'électrification des véhicules ferroviaires, des autobus et industriels. Une gamme complète de solutions de propulsion, auxiliaires et de stockage d'énergie à haute performance et à cycle de vie complet contribue à améliorer l'efficacité énergétique et à rendre le transport plus durable.


Emplacement
Ce rôle est ouvert à l'échelle mondiale, avec des emplacements privilégiés en Suisse (Untersiggenthal), en Italie (Genova), en Allemagne (Minden, Berlin) et en Pologne (Aleksandrow Lodzki, Łódш).
Le modèle de travail est hybride et exige une présence régulière sur place dans les usines et les fournisseurs. L'équilibre de l'IL


Clé • Responsabilités


• Définir et mettre en oeuvre la stratégie globale de qualité conforme aux priorités opérationnelles, aux politiques de qualité et aux exigences du SGQ.
• Diriger l'organisation mondiale de la qualité, en favorisant une culture de qualité uniforme dans toutes les régions.
• Établir un solide cycle de qualité en boucle fermée, du développement à la rétroaction des clients.
• Conduire des normes mondiales de qualité des fournisseurs, d'assurance de la qualité de la production, d'essai et d'inspection.

• Mettre en oeuvre et superviser les processus, les vérifications, les modèles de gouvernance et les cadres d'amélioration continue à l'échelle mondiale.
• Assurer une forte participation de la qualité à l'élaboration des produits et des procédés, y compris la planification structurée de la qualité, le PAQ/PPAP (le cas échéant) et la détection précoce des risques.

• Qualifications


• 10+ années d'expérience en qualité, en génie ou en opérations dans des environnements industriels complexes ou conçus pour commander.
• Expérience éprouvée de l'amélioration de la qualité, du leadership en résolution de problèmes et de la prise de décision axée sur les données.
• Diplôme d'ingénieur (mécanique, électrique, industriel ou similaire) ou formation technique équivalente.
• Une solide expertise en systèmes de qualité, gouvernance QMS, RCA, et des méthodologies telles que 8D, Lean et l'expérience dans les environnements automobiles, ferroviaires ou d'équipement lourd; la connaissance de l'APQP, PPAP, DFMEA/PFMEA est un plus fort
• Capacité démontrée de diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles et d'influencer les intervenants dans une organisation matricielle mondiale.
• La connaissance des normes de l'industrie comme les normes IRIS, EN/IEC et les exigences réglementaires relatives à la traction/rail est un avantage.
• Excellentes compétences en communication, anglais couramment et disponibilité pour voyager jusqu'à 30 %

Nous vous donnons les moyens de prendre des initiatives, de contester les idées et de diriger avec confiance. Rejoignez-nous. Faites partie de l'équipe où le progrès se produit, les industries se transforment, et votre travail façonne le monde. Exécuter What Runs the World.

jobs.title: Material Planner
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Fulfillment Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end planning and management of inventory, ensuring an efficient flow from purchase requisition through to customer invoicing and delivery execution. A strong focus will be placed on planning activities, including order portfolio management, inventory optimization, replenishment strategies, and the definition of inventory parameters and targets to guarantee material availability and service level performance.

The work model for the role is onsite. #LI-Onsite

This role is contributing to the IPU in Quartino, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are the P&F, OP&L, Logistics, IPU Stand Alone, Modular and B&S.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining inventory policies based on specified segmentation, including ABC/XYZ analysis to optimize inventory strategies, stock levels, and service performance in terms of ROTD

  • Calculating and maintaining the inventory parameters, including safety stock, reorder point, lot size, lead time, and replenishment strategies, in SAP

  • Coordinating material planning with call-offs to ensure that purchase requisitions are converted into purchase orders in collaboration with operations, buyers, and services

  • Collaborating with buyers to achieve the best possible supplier performance in terms of supplier on-time delivery, Minimum Order Quantity, quality, lead time, and flexibility

  • Demonstrating solid knowledge of logistics flows and operational dynamics to ensure efficient material availability, inventory management, and end-to-end supply chain coordination


• Qualifications for the role:

  • +5 years of experience in material planning

  • Degree in Management Engineering/Economics as a preferred qualification

  • Good skills in data analysis, structured thinking, teamwork, and communication

  • Profound knowledge in SAP MM/PP, MS Excel, and Power BI

  • Fluency in Italian and English

More about us:

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Fulfillment Lead


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten:

< In dieser Rolle sind Sie für die End-to-End-Planung und -Verwaltung des Lagerbestands verantwortlich und gewährleisten einen effizienten Fluss von der Kaufanforderung bis hin zur Rechnungsstellung und Lieferausführung. Ein starker Fokus wird auf Planungsaktivitäten gelegt, einschließlich Auftragsportfoliomanagement, Bestandsoptimierung, Wiederauffüllungsstrategien und der Definition von Bestandsparametern und -zielen, um die Materialverfügbarkeit und die Serviceleistung zu gewährleisten.

> Diese Rolle trägt dazu bei die IPU in Quartino, Switzerland. Hauptbeteiligte sind die P&F, OP&L, Logistik, IPU Stand Alone, Modular und B&S.









  • Definieren von Bestandsrichtlinien basierend auf spezifizierter Segmentierung, einschließlich ABC/XYZ-Analyse zur Optimierung von Bestandsstrategien, Lagerbeständen und Service-Performance in Bezug auf ROTD

  • Berechnung und Pflege der Bestandsparameter, einschließlich Sicherheitsbestand, Reorderpunkt, Losgröße, Vorlaufzeit und Nachschubstrategien, in SAP

  • Koordination der Materialplanung mit Abrufen, um sicherzustellen, dass Kaufanforderungen in Zusammenarbeit mit Betrieben, Käufern und Dienstleistungen in Kaufaufträge umgewandelt werden

  • Zusammenarbeit mit Käufern, um die bestmögliche Lieferantenleistung in Bezug auf termingerechte Lieferung, Mindestbestellmenge, Qualität, Vorlaufzeit und Flexibilität zu erzielen

  • Nachweis solider Kenntnisse der Logistikflüsse und der Betriebsdynamik, um eine effiziente Materialverfügbarkeit, Bestandsverwaltung und End-to-End-Koordination der Lieferkette zu gewährleisten


Qualifikationen für die Rolle: Die technischen Teams der Division arbeiten eng mit Industriepartnern zusammen und liefern fortschrittliche Lösungen, die schnelles Wachstum, Energiewende und Nachhaltigkeitsziele unterstützen. Das Portfolio der Division umfasst industrielle Leistungsschalter, Niederspannungssysteme, Motorstartanwendungen und Sicherheitsgeräte wie Schalter und Relais. Seine Power Protection-Einheit unterstützt die weltweit größten Rechenzentrumsunternehmen mit fortschrittlichen energieeffizienten USV-Lösungen. Der ABB AbilityTM Energy Manager der Division bietet eine skalierbare, benutzerfreundliche Plattform, mit der Unternehmen Energie sparen und CO2-Emissionen reduzieren können.

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

jobs.title: (Senior) Research Scientist in Software Systems Engineering (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Department Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a research scientist in Software Systems Engineering, you will be working on the future architecture and design of ABB’s software-based products, with a special focus on the digitalization of industrial systems. We are looking for a team member with a proven research track record and the eagerness to transfer and apply world class academic research into an industrial environment. You will work within the highly motivated, international team of scientists at ABB Research. • We offer an open and innovative international work environment with many diverse opportunities to grow your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Contribute to and/or lead research projects that turn state-of-the-art research results into effective software solutions for ABB.
  • Create prototypes of innovative concepts with real business impact
  • Evaluate new technologies and assess their impact on ABB products and roadmaps.
  • Disseminate your results in scientific publications, patent applications, and technical reports.
  • Build a network in the company and actively disseminate your knowledge and expertise.


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering or in a related field

  • Experience in software engineering and system design
  • Theoretical and practical knowledge in one or multiple of the following topics: software engineering, distributed systems, computer networking, embedded systems, machine learning, cyber security
  • Hands-on experience in programming languages (e.g., C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Proven publication track record at top scientific conferences and journals
  • Excellent communication skills and team player attitude
  • Solid experience of getting ideas from concepts to prototypes


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Flexible Work Practices
  • Employee Share Acquisition Plan
  • Canteen

More about us


At the ABB Research Center located in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on cutting-edge technologies that shape the future of our products. The Industrial Software Systems research team explores topics like machine learning, cybersecurity, computer networking, distributed systems, and real-time systems. Our solutions are used to support the development of next-generation digital products and services of ABB.

We look forward to receiving your application (documents submitted in English are appreciated). If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

What's in it for you:

We empower you to take initiative, explore new possibilities, and lead with confidence. You’ll grow through meaningful work, continuous learning, and support that’s tailored to your goals. Every idea you share and every action you take contributes to something bigger.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Your role and verantwortung

Als wissenschaftlicher Mitarbeiter im Bereich Software Systems Engineering beschäftigen Sie sich mit der zukünftigen Architektur und dem Design der softwarebasierten Produkte von ABB, mit besonderem Fokus auf der Digitalisierung industrieller Systeme. Wir suchen ein Teammitglied mit einer nachgewiesenen Forschungsbilanz und dem Eifer, erstklassige akademische Forschung in ein industrielles Umfeld zu übertragen und anzuwenden. Sie arbeiten im hochmotivierten, internationalen Team von Wissenschaftlern bei ABB Research. • Wir bieten ein offenes und innovatives internationales Arbeitsumfeld mit vielen verschiedenen Möglichkeiten, Ihre Karriere zu entwickeln.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle ist: #LI-hybrid



Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Beitragen und/oder leiten Sie Forschungsprojekte, die modernste Forschungsergebnisse in effektive Softwarelösungen für ABB verwandeln.
  • Prototypen innovativer Konzepte mit realer Geschäftswirkung erstellen
  • Neue Technologien bewerten und deren Auswirkungen auf ABB Produkte und Roadmaps bewerten.
  • Verbreiten Sie Ihre Ergebnisse in wissenschaftlichen Publikationen, Patentanmeldungen und technischen Berichten.
  • Bauen Sie ein Netzwerk im Unternehmen auf und verbreiten Sie aktiv Ihr Wissen und Ihre Expertise.


• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • PhD in Informatik, Computertechnik, Elektrotechnik oder in einem verwandten Bereich

  • Erfahrung in Software Engineering und Systemdesign
  • Theoretische und praktische Kenntnisse in einem oder mehreren der folgenden Themen: Software Engineering, verteilte Systeme, Computernetzwerke, eingebettete Systeme, maschinelles Lernen, Cybersicherheit
  • Praktische Erfahrung in Programmiersprachen (z. B. C/C++, Python, Rust)
  • Nachgewiesene Veröffentlichungsbilanz auf führenden wissenschaftlichen Konferenzen und Fachzeitschriften
  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Teamplayer-Haltung





    • Mehr über uns

Das Forschungsteam für industrielle Softwaresysteme untersucht Themen wie maschinelles Lernen, Cybersicherheit, Computernetzwerke, verteilte Systeme und Echtzeitsysteme. Unsere Lösungen unterstützen die Entwicklung digitaler Produkte und Dienstleistungen der nächsten Generation von ABB.

    Wir befähigen Sie, Initiative zu ergreifen, neue Möglichkeiten zu erkunden und mit Zuversicht zu führen. Sie werden durch sinnvolle Arbeit, kontinuierliches Lernen und Unterstützung wachsen, die auf Ihre Ziele zugeschnitten ist. Jede Idee, die Sie teilen und jede Aktion, die Sie ausführen, trägt zu etwas Größerem bei.

    Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

En tant que chercheur en génie des systèmes logiciels, vous travaillerez sur l'architecture et la conception futures des produits logiciels ABB, avec un accent particulier sur la numérisation des systèmes industriels. jobs.title: Global Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Global Project Execution Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities:

In this role, you will have the opportunity to shape and elevate our global engineering function, providing strategic direction and leadership across Engineering Units within Sales and Solutions Global Solutions Centers.

You will drive team growth and capability development, fostering a culture of collaboration, continuous learning, and process excellence to strengthen our engineering and design expertise.

You will also ensure outstanding project execution, supporting teams to deliver high-quality solutions that meet customer expectations, safety and compliance standards, and business performance goals — on time and within budget.


The work model for the role is: hybrid

Position location: Global

This role is contributing to the Electrification Distribution Solutions Business Division.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Shape and lead our engineering and design strategy, verify the design robustness inside and across regions and ensure strong governance and operational excellence while aligning with broader business goals.

  • Lead and oversee Engineering Leaders and Teams located in different regions.

  • Drive performance and delivery excellence, setting clear KPIs and supporting teams to achieve results on time, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

  • Build trusted, long-term customer partnerships, collaborating closely to understand needs, identify opportunities, and co-create innovative solutions.

  • Strengthen engineering capabilities and ways of working, fostering continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and consistent frameworks across teams.

  • Lead, coach, and empower diverse teams, creating an inclusive environment where people can grow, contribute, and perform at their best while upholding HSE and integrity standards.

  • Contribute to the training of Engineering Teams and Service Teams

  • Proactively manage risks and opportunities, embedding structured review processes that support sustainable growth and informed decision-making.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Deep knowledge of MV/LV systems, System design (Protection and Control, Automation, Auxiliary systems), eHouse solutions and Switchgear engineering processes with experience in EPC engineering business.

  • Sound knowledge of Data Center applications for Hyperscale and Colocations

  • Experience of commissioning activities and quality procedures for FAT and SAT.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, enabling effective collaboration across functions, regions, and organizational levels.

More about us

Electrification provides leading electrical distribution and management technologies, solutions and services to electrify the world in a safe, smart and sustainable way. The portfolio includes medium- and ow-voltage electrical components, switchgear, digital devices, enclosures, and circuit breakers, among others. With our products, solutions and services, we collaborate with customers to improve power delivery and security, enhance energy management, efficiency and operational reliability, as we seek to achieve a low carbon society. go.abb/electrification

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: ABB Discovery Trainee – Mining Service (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Local Business Line Service Manager & Head of Service Operations

__

Are you ready for new adventures, eager to work on real projects, and driven to shape a productive and sustainable future?

Our ABB Discovery Trainee Program offers a unique entry opportunity with a dynamic role and a motivated team. Experience the operations of an international company firsthand during three different six months assignments over the course of a total of 18 months structured around the topic of Service in Mining.

ABB is a trusted partner to the global mining industry, delivering and supporting critical electrical, automation, and digital infrastructure across mining operations. Our installed base includes power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, motors, protection relays, automation systems, and industrial cybersecurity solutions that enable safe, reliable, and efficient operations. Through our global service organization, we help customers maximize asset performance, improve operational resilience, reduce downtime, and achieve their sustainability goals. As the mining industry continues its journey toward electrification, digitalization, and autonomous operations, ABB is uniquely positioned to develop innovative service solutions that create long-term value for customers.

Through a personalized, practice-oriented introduction, you will gain the confidence to work independently and as part of inclusive teams. ABB offers various development opportunities and training to enhance your skills and fast-track your career.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid.

Start date of the program is October 1, 2026. The selection process is taking place between June and July 2026.

Your main availabilities will be:

  • Assignment 1 – Switzerland: Collaborate with the Service Product Management, Service Sales, and Service Project Management teams to gain a comprehensive understanding of ABB's service portfolio, customer challenges, and business drivers. Working closely with technical and commercial stakeholders, support the identification of portfolio gaps and growth opportunities, particularly in the areas of automation, industrial cybersecurity, and electrification, and contribute to the development of future service solutions.
    Assignment 2 – International Assignment: Join an ABB unit abroad and work closely with local teams and customers to gain first-hand exposure to operational challenges, market dynamics, and customer needs. Contribute to identifying opportunities where ABB's service offerings can enhance reliability, productivity, sustainability, and operational performance.
    Assignment 3 – Switzerland: Shape your final assignment together with the business based on organizational priorities and your interests. Potential areas of focus would be in an engineering team, working closely with subject matter experts where you will strengthen your technical foundation while contributing to initiatives that support service innovation, portfolio development, and business growth. Additional collaboration with Product Management, Strategy, and Business Development teams may be included depending on business priorities.
  • Engage in challenging assignments that provide exposure to different functions, allowing you to build a broad understanding of ABB's service business while developing your technical, commercial, and leadership capabilities.
  • Benefit from personalized training, professional mentoring, executive exposure, and continuous support from the Discovery Program team, while receiving regular feedback to accelerate your development.
  • Actively participate in social events and team activities, build a global network across ABB, and become part of our vibrant Discovery Trainee community.

jobs.title: Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer for SST (f/m/d) 80-100%
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced R&D Senior Engineer with focus on Quality and Reliability to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D Power Electronics center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer will have special focus on performing theoretical and experimental reliability analysis at components, sub-assemblies and at a system level, as well as linking the findings to the Quality assurance plans with special emphasis to the identified critical elements and their critical to quality parameters from the design phase to the ramp-up of the production and the life cycle management of the SST products. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with future relocation possibilities to other production locations.

The main responsibilities include

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the reliability analyses and assessment for Power Electronics Components (e.g. semiconductors, control HW, capacitors, fans, etc.), assemblies, and subsystems utilizing statistical methods and tools for reliability prediction and modelling (MTFB/ FIT). This is to be performed in close collaboration with the R&D team, including the identification risks and defining the corresponding mitigation actions and reliability design guidelines through tools such as Failure Modes and Effect Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, Physics of Failure methodologies, electrical, mechanical and thermal stress analysis, test data review and assessment and reference to relevant industry standards.

  • Lead the reliability plans and quality requirements including internal and suppliers’ reliability and quality testing plans as well as supporting the internal quality assurance actions involving the internal supply chain management, production and operation teams. This includes the identification of patterns and trends related to reliability, quality and performance from internal and external reliability testing and production data as well as root case analysis and corrective and preventive actions for issues identified during the R&D Validation and Qualification phases, Production and Field Operation.

  • Provide close support and collaboration with the productization and operations teams for the SST product quality assurance plans development and maintenance for mass production and fleet performance tracking. This includes internal and external audits, routine and screening testing activities, Statistical Process Control monitoring, documentation management and quality KPIs definition, monitoring and reporting to ensure product conformity and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Actively contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team with focus on robust design for reliability and quality assurance.

You will be part of advanced R&D and productization activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and stakeholders in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University Master’s degree / PhD in the field of engineering (electrical, mechatronics, etc.), or Equivalent Experience in the field of reliability and quality engineering with focus on Power Electronics products. Experience in the field of Medium Voltage and High Power converters is a plus.

  • Solid background know-how and expertise in Reliability analysis, testing and assessment, with direct impact to product design, production quality plans and mitigation actions identification applying state of the art reliability and quality tools and methods.

  • Experience and high interest in theoretical and practical reliability and quality assurance activities related to Power Electronics products development and lifecycle management for mass production, including interaction and communication with different stakeholders.

  • Interest in applied research and product development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

  • Fluency in written and spoken English. German is a plus.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

SST Product Architect

__

Your role and responsibilities

We are seeking an enthusiastic and experienced R&D Senior Engineer with focus on Quality and Reliability to be part of the expansion of our business with a novel solid state transformer technology for datacenter applications. In this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of the ELDS R&D Power Electronics center of excellence team for Solid State Transformer in charge of the design and development of the future Solid State Transformer products family with first focus on Data Center application requirements. In this context, and as part of the R&D SST development team, the Power Electronics Quality and Reliability Senior R&D Engineer will have special focus on performing theoretical and experimental reliability analysis at components, sub-assemblies and at a system level, as well as linking the findings to the Quality assurance plans with special emphasis to the identified critical elements and their critical to quality parameters from the design phase to the ramp-up of the production and the life cycle management of the SST products. The location for this position is Baden-Daettwil in Switzerland, with future relocation possibilities to other production locations.

The main responsibilities include

  • Member of the SST for Data Center R&D team, leading the reliability analyses and assessment for Power Electronics Components (e.g. semiconductors, control HW, capacitors, fans, etc.), assemblies, and subsystems utilizing statistical methods and tools for reliability prediction and modelling (MTFB/ FIT). This is to be performed in close collaboration with the R&D team, including the identification risks and defining the corresponding mitigation actions and reliability design guidelines through tools such as Failure Modes and Effect Analysis, Fault Tree Analysis, Physics of Failure methodologies, electrical, mechanical and thermal stress analysis, test data review and assessment and reference to relevant industry standards.

  • Lead the reliability plans and quality requirements including internal and suppliers’ reliability and quality testing plans as well as supporting the internal quality assurance actions involving the internal supply chain management, production and operation teams. This includes the identification of patterns and trends related to reliability, quality and performance from internal and external reliability testing and production data as well as root case analysis and corrective and preventive actions for issues identified during the R&D Validation and Qualification phases, Production and Field Operation.

  • Provide close support and collaboration with the productization and operations teams for the SST product quality assurance plans development and maintenance for mass production and fleet performance tracking. This includes internal and external audits, routine and screening testing activities, Statistical Process Control monitoring, documentation management and quality KPIs definition, monitoring and reporting to ensure product conformity and continuous improvement throughout the product lifecycle.

  • Actively contribution to the maintenance and further development of the key Power Electronics Technologies Expertise and Know-How of the SST for Datacenters R&D team with focus on robust design for reliability and quality assurance.

You will be part of advanced R&D and productization activities in the field of power electronics for the ABB SST for Datacenter Products, in close cooperation with a highly qualified senior team of R&D engineers and stakeholders in a global and multicultural setup.

• Qualifications for the role

  • University Master’s degree / PhD in the field of engineering (electrical, mechatronics, etc.), or Equivalent Experience in the field of reliability and quality engineering with focus on Power Electronics products. Experience in the field of Medium Voltage and High Power converters is a plus.

  • Solid background know-how and expertise in Reliability analysis, testing and assessment, with direct impact to product design, production quality plans and mitigation actions identification applying state of the art reliability and quality tools and methods.

  • Experience and high interest in theoretical and practical reliability and quality assurance activities related to Power Electronics products development and lifecycle management for mass production, including interaction and communication with different stakeholders.

  • Interest in applied research and product development, self-organized, motivated person, that likes to work in a highly qualified research and development team composed of experts in different domains and global locations.

At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, das zu steuern, was die Welt beherrscht.

Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Zu den Hauptaufgaben gehören

  • Mitglied des SST for Data Center R&D-Teams, das die Zuverlässigkeitsanalysen und -bewertung für Leistungselektronikkomponenten (z. B. Halbleiter, Steuerungs-HW, Kondensatoren, Ventilatoren usw.), Baugruppen und Subsysteme leitet, die statistische Methoden und Werkzeuge für Zuverlässigkeitsvorhersage und -modellierung (MTFB/FIT) verwenden. Dies ist in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem F&E-Team durchzuführen, einschließlich der Identifizierungsrisiken und der Festlegung der entsprechenden Minderungsmaßnahmen und Zuverlässigkeitsrichtlinien durch Tools wie Fehlermodi und Wirkungsanalyse, Fehlerbaumanalyse, Methoden der Physik des Versagens, elektrische, mechanische und thermische Belastungsanalyse, Überprüfung und Bewertung von Testdaten und Verweis auf relevante Industriestandards.

Dies umfasst die Identifizierung von Mustern und Trends in Bezug auf Zuverlässigkeit, Qualität und Leistung aus internen und externen Zuverlässigkeitstests und Produktionsdaten sowie Root-Case-Analysen und Korrektur- und Präventivmaßnahmen für Probleme, die während der F & E-Validierungs- und Qualifizierungsphasen, Produktion und Feldbetrieb identifiziert wurden.

Dazu gehören interne und externe Audits, Routine- und Screening-Tests, Überwachung der statistischen Prozesskontrolle, Dokumentationsmanagement und Qualitäts-KPIs Definition, Überwachung und Berichterstattung, um die Produktkonformität und kontinuierliche Verbesserung während des gesamten Produktlebenszyklus zu gewährleisten.

  • Tätig Beitrag zur Wartung und Weiterentwicklung der wichtigsten Power Electronics Technologies Expertise und Know-How des SST for Datacenters R&D-Teams mit Schwerpunkt auf robustem Design für Zuverlässigkeit und Qualitätssicherung.

Sie werden Teil der fortgeschrittenen F & E- und Produktisierungsaktivitäten im Bereich Leistungselektronik für das ABB SST für Datacenter-Produkte sein, in enger Zusammenarbeit mit einem hochqualifizierten Senior-Team von F & E-Ingenieuren und Stakeholdern in einem globalen und multikulturellen Setup. • Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • University Master / PhD im Bereich Engineering (Elektrik, Mechatronik, etc.) oder gleichwertige Erfahrung im Bereich Zuverlässigkeit und Qualitätstechnik mit Schwerpunkt auf Power Electronics Produkte. Erfahrung auf dem Gebiet der Mittelspannungs- und Hochleistungswandler ist ein Plus.

  • Solid Hintergrund Know-how und Know-how in der Zuverlässigkeitsanalyse, Prüfung und Bewertung, mit direkten Auswirkungen auf Produktdesign, Produktionsqualitätspläne und Minderungsmaßnahmen Identifizierung Stand der Technik Zuverlässigkeit und Qualität Werkzeuge und Methoden.

  • Erfahrung und großes Interesse an theoretischen und praktischen Zuverlässigkeit und Qualitätssicherung Aktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Power Electronics Produkte Entwicklung und Lebenszyklusmanagement für die Massenproduktion, einschließlich Interaktion und Kommunikation mit verschiedenen Stakeholdern.

  • Interesse an angewandter Forschung und Produktentwicklung, selbstorganisierte, motivierte Person, die gerne in einem hochqualifizierten Forschungs- und Entwicklungsteam arbeitet, das sich aus Experten in verschiedenen Bereichen und globalen Standorten zusammensetzt.

  • Fluency in schriftlichem und gesprochenem Englisch. Deutsch ist ein Plus.

  • Verfügbarkeit für sporadische Reisen.

>Die ABB-Division Distribution Solutions ermöglicht die effiziente und zuverlässige Verteilung, den Schutz und die Steuerung von Strom durch Verbesserung der Stromqualität bei gleichzeitiger Stärkung der Widerstandsfähigkeit des Netzes.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

SST Product Architect

Votre rôle et responsabilités

Nous recherchons un ingénieur principal en R-D enthousiaste et expérimenté qui mettra l'accent sur la qualité et la fiabilité pour faire partie de l'expansion de notre entreprise avec une nouvelle technologie de transformateur d'état solide pour les applications de datacenter. Dans ce rôle, vous aurez l'occasion de faire partie de l'équipe d'excellence ELDS R&D Power Electronics pour Solid State Transformer en charge de la conception et du développement de la future famille de produits Solid State Transformer avec un premier accent sur les exigences d'application Data Center. Dans ce contexte, et dans le cadre de l'équipe de développement de la SST en R-D, l'ingénieur principal en R-D en qualité et fiabilité de l'électronique de puissance mettra tout particulièrement l'accent sur l'analyse théorique et expérimentale de la fiabilité des composants, des sous-ensembles et des systèmes, ainsi que sur l'établissement d'un lien entre les résultats et les plans d'assurance de la qualité, en mettant particulièrement l'accent sur les éléments critiques identifiés et leurs paramètres critiques pour la qualité, de la phase de conception à la montée en puissance de la production et la gestion du cycle de vie des produits de la SST. L'emplacement de ce poste est Baden-Daettwil en Suisse, avec de futures possibilités de relocalisation vers d'autres sites de production.

Les principales responsabilités comprennent

  • Membre de l'équipe de R-D du Centre de données, qui dirige les analyses et l'évaluation de la fiabilité des composants de Power Electronics (p. ex. semi-conducteurs, contrôle HW, condensateurs, ventilateurs, etc.), des assemblages et des sous-systèmes utilisant des méthodes et des outils statistiques pour la prédiction et la modélisation de la fiabilité (MTFB/FIT). Cela doit être effectué en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe de R-D, y compris l'identification des risques et la définition des mesures d'atténuation correspondantes et des lignes directrices sur la conception de la fiabilité au moyen d'outils comme l'analyse des modes et des effets de défaillance, l'analyse des arbres de défaillance, les méthodologies de physique de défaillance, l'analyse des contraintes électriques, mécaniques et thermiques, l'examen et l'évaluation des données d'essai et la référence aux normes pertinentes de l'industrie.

  • Diriger les plans de fiabilité et les exigences de qualité, y compris les plans internes et les plans d'essais de fiabilité et de qualité des fournisseurs, ainsi que soutenir les actions internes d'assurance de la qualité impliquant les équipes internes de gestion, de production et d'exploitation de la chaîne d'approvisionnement. Cela comprend l'identification des modèles et des tendances liés à la fiabilité, à la qualité et au rendement à partir des données internes et externes sur la fiabilité et la production, ainsi que l'analyse des cas de base et les mesures correctives et préventives pour les questions identifiées au cours des phases de validation et de qualification de la R-D, de la production et de l'exploitation sur le terrain.

  • Fournir un soutien et une collaboration étroits avec les équipes de production et d'exploitation pour l'élaboration et la maintenance de plans d'assurance de la qualité des produits SST pour la production de masse et le suivi des performances de la flotte. Cela comprend les vérifications internes et externes, les activités d'essai de routine et de dépistage, la surveillance du contrôle des processus statistiques, la gestion de la documentation et la définition des ICR de qualité, la surveillance et l'établissement de rapports afin d'assurer la conformité des produits et l'amélioration continue tout au long du cycle de vie du produit.

  • Contribution active à la maintenance et au développement de l'expertise et du savoir-faire clés en matière de technologies de l'électronique de puissance pour l'équipe de R-D des centres de données, en mettant l'accent sur une conception robuste pour assurer la fiabilité et la qualité.

Vous participerez à des activités de R-D et de production de pointe dans le domaine de l'électronique de puissance pour les produits ABB SST for Datacenter, en étroite collaboration avec une équipe supérieure hautement qualifiée d'ingénieurs et d'intervenants en R-D dans une installation mondiale et multiculturelle.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Maîtrise universitaire / doctorat en génie (électrique, mécatronique, etc.), ou expérience équivalente dans le domaine de la fiabilité et de l'ingénierie de la qualité en mettant l'accent sur les produits Power Electronics. L'expérience acquise dans le domaine des convertisseurs à moyenne tension et à haute puissance est un atout.

  • Savoir-faire et savoir-faire solides en matière d'analyse, d'essai et d'évaluation de la fiabilité, avec une incidence directe sur la conception du produit, les plans de qualité de la production et les mesures d'atténuation, en appliquant les outils et les méthodes de fiabilité et de qualité les plus récents.

  • Expérience et grand intérêt pour les activités théoriques et pratiques de fiabilité et d'assurance de la qualité liées au développement de produits Power Electronics et à la gestion du cycle de vie pour la production de masse, y compris l'interaction et la communication avec les différents intervenants.

  • Intérêt pour la recherche appliquée et le développement de produits, personne auto-organisée et motivée, qui aime travailler dans une équipe de recherche et de développement hautement qualifiée composée d'experts dans différents domaines et à l'échelle mondiale.

  • L'allemand est un plus.

  • Disponibilité de voyager sporadiquement.

Plus sur nous

La Division des solutions de distribution d'ABB facilite la distribution, la protection et le contrôle efficaces et fiables de l'énergie en améliorant la qualité de l'électricité tout en renforçant la résilience du réseau.

La Division offre des produits et des solutions spécifiques à certains segments qui servent en grande partie les secteurs des services publics, de l'industrie et de l'infrastructure, fournissant souvent le lien nécessaire entre les systèmes de transmission à haute tension et les utilisateurs à faible tension.

Avec les solutions connectées ABB CapabilityTM à son cœur, l'offre comprend les commutateurs à moyenne tension à air et à gaz (1 à 66 kilovolts), les disjoncteurs intérieurs et extérieurs, les refermeurs, les fusibles, les contacteurs, les relais, les transformateurs d'instruments, les capteurs, les centres de commande moteur, ainsi que les commutateurs à basse tension.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande (les documents présentés en anglais sont appréciés).

Le processus de recrutement est dirigé par Ece Özen, Talent Partner chez ABB Switzerland Ltd.


Construire un avenir plus propre et plus intelligent prend toutes sortes d'esprits : les curieux, les courageux et les créatifs. C'est pourquoi nous accueillons des gens de tous les horizons et de toutes les expériences.

Prêt à faire un impact?

Appliquer aujourd'hui ou visiter https://www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems

__

Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovation at the intersection of power electronic converters and electromagnetics, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on electromagnetic modeling of power converter systems and components, conducted and radiat-ed emissions mitigation, passive and active filtering strategies, and shielding. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems — generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that advance ABB's product portfolio.


Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through electromagnetics research in pow-er converter systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to wel-come you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid


You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Pioneer innovative concepts for ensuring electromagnetic compatibility and interference compliance in high-power converters

  • Develop EMC models to predict and analyze electromagnetic compatibility and optimize electromagnetic design of circuits and systems

  • EMC measurements of conducted and radiated emissions of converters and HF characterization of components

  • Patent innovative solutions and demonstrate technology leadership through e.g., high-impact publications

  • Collaborate closely with ABB research centers, business units, and universities to transition research into real-world applications


• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in electrical engineering, physics or related discipline with specialization in power electronics or electromagnetics

  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents

  • Deep technical expertise in:

    • EMC/EMI theory and solid theoretical background in electromagnetic modelling and field simulations

    • Power electronic converter topologies, filters, magnetics, and semiconductor switching devices

    • Simulation tools such as CST, COMSOL, ANSYS, SPICE circuit simulator (LTSpice, SIMetrix), Simulink

  • Hands-on laboratory skills in HF-electromagnetic measurements (conducted and/or radiated emissions), with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing EMC/EMI-compliant power converters. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.

  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results

  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal


Benefits

We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Canteen

  • Flexible work practices

  • Childcare


More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.



Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Senior Key Account Manager


At the Sevensense office in Zurich, we push the frontiers of Visual SLAM and build the eyes and brains for ABB’s mobile robots. Our real-time tracking solutions provide warehouses and factories with instant visibility into their forklift traffic, utilization, and safety. We’re looking for a passionate Technical Sales Specialist to join our Marketing & Sales team in Zurich, Switzerland.

• Your responsibilities:

  • Proactively identify new business opportunities and grow our customer base

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all matters specific to your accounts

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships

  • Develop sales opportunities by leveraging our success stories

  • Deeply understand the customer needs and derive a compelling value proposition for our Visual SLAM solutions

  • Coordinate commercial inquiries with our Account Managers

  • Focus your activities on our forklift tracking solution: identify key players and their needs, and generate leads to grow the sales in that domain

  • Support product evaluations and integrations in close collaboration with our Application Engineers and Project Managers, securing high sales volumes and customer satisfaction

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Completed university degree in a technical discipline

  • Previous experience in a coordinating

descriptionByLocale.it:
In ABB aiutiamo le industrie a superare le aspettative: più snelle e più pulite. Qui, il progresso è un'aspettativa: per te, per il tuo team e per il mondo. In qualità di leader del mercato globale, ti forniremo ciò di cui hai bisogno per realizzarlo. Non sarà sempre facile, crescere richiede grinta. Ma in ABB non sarai mai solo. Gestisci ciò che governa il mondo. Questo ruolo rientra nel business Robotics di ABB, una delle principali società di robotica a livello mondiale. Stiamo entrando in un nuovo entusiasmante capitolo poiché abbiamo annunciato il piano per il gruppo SoftBank di acquisire ABB Robotics. SoftBank è un gruppo tecnologico riconosciuto a livello mondiale e un investitore/operatore specializzato in intelligenza artificiale, robotica e informatica di prossima generazione. Unendoti a noi ora, farai parte di un team pionieristico che plasma il futuro della robotica, lavorando a fianco di esperti di livello mondiale in un ambiente in rapida evoluzione e guidato dall’innovazione. Questa posizione riporta a: Senior Key Account Manager Presso l'ufficio Sevensense di Zurigo, spingiamo le frontiere del Visual SLAM e costruiamo gli occhi e il cervello per i robot mobili di ABB. Le nostre soluzioni di monitoraggio in tempo reale forniscono ai magazzini e alle fabbriche una visibilità immediata sul traffico, sull'utilizzo e sulla sicurezza dei carrelli elevatori. Stiamo cercando uno specialista tecnico delle vendite appassionato che si unisca al nostro team di marketing e vendite a Zurigo, Svizzera.
• Le tue responsabilità: - Identificare in modo proattivo nuove opportunità di business e ampliare la nostra base di clienti - Servire come punto di contatto principale per tutte le questioni specifiche dei tuoi account - Costruire e mantenere relazioni con i clienti forti e durature - Sviluppare opportunità di vendita sfruttando le nostre storie di successo - Comprendere a fondo le esigenze dei clienti e ricavare una proposta di valore convincente per le nostre soluzioni Visual SLAM - Coordinare le richieste commerciali con i nostri Account Manager - Concentrare le attività sulla nostra soluzione di tracciamento dei carrelli elevatori: identificare gli attori chiave e le loro esigenze e generare contatti per aumentare le vendite in quel dominio - Supportare le valutazioni e le integrazioni dei prodotti in stretta collaborazione con i nostri ingegneri applicativi e project manager, garantendo elevati volumi di vendita e soddisfazione del cliente
• Qualifiche per il ruolo: - Laurea universitaria completa in una disciplina tecnica - Precedente esperienza in un ruolo di coordinamento

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir Branchen, ihre Konkurrenz zu übertreffen – schlanker und sauberer. Hier wird Fortschritt erwartet – für Sie, Ihr Team und die Welt. Als globaler Marktführer geben wir Ihnen alles, was Sie brauchen, um dies zu erreichen. Es wird nicht immer einfach sein, das Wachstum erfordert Mut. Aber bei ABB sind Sie nie allein. Führen Sie, was die Welt regiert. Diese Rolle ist innerhalb des Robotikgeschäfts von ABB angesiedelt, einem führenden globalen Robotikunternehmen. Wir beginnen ein aufregendes neues Kapitel, da wir den Plan der SoftBank Group zur Übernahme von ABB Robotics bekannt gegeben haben. SoftBank ist ein weltweit anerkannter Technologiekonzern und Investor/Betreiber mit Schwerpunkt auf KI, Robotik und Computing der nächsten Generation. Wenn Sie jetzt bei uns einsteigen, werden Sie Teil eines Pionierteams, das die Zukunft der Robotik gestaltet und mit erstklassigen Experten in einem schnelllebigen, innovationsgetriebenen Umfeld arbeitet. Diese Position berichtet an: Senior Key Account Manager Im Sevensense-Büro in Zürich erweitern wir die Grenzen von Visual SLAM und bauen die Augen und Gehirne für die mobilen Roboter von ABB. Unsere Echtzeit-Tracking-Lösungen bieten Lagern und Fabriken sofortige Einblicke in den Gabelstaplerverkehr, die Auslastung und die Sicherheit. Wir suchen einen leidenschaftlichen technischen Vertriebsspezialisten zur Verstärkung unseres Marketing- und Vertriebsteams in Zürich, Schweiz.
• Ihre Aufgaben: - Proaktiv neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten identifizieren und unseren Kundenstamm erweitern - Als Hauptansprechpartner für alle kundenbezogenen Angelegenheiten fungieren - Starke, langfristige Kundenbeziehungen aufbauen und pflegen - Verkaufschancen durch Nutzung unserer Erfolgsgeschichten entwickeln - Die Kundenbedürfnisse genau verstehen und ein überzeugendes Wertversprechen für unsere Visual SLAM-Lösungen ableiten - Kommerzielle Anfragen mit unseren Account Managern koordinieren - Konzentrieren Sie Ihre Aktivitäten auf unsere Forklift-Tracking-Lösung: Identifizieren Sie wichtige Akteure und ihre Bedürfnisse und generieren Sie Leads, um den Umsatz in diesem Bereich zu steigern - Unterstützen Sie Produktbewertungen und -integrationen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Anwendungsingenieuren und Projektmanagern und sichern Sie so hohe Verkaufsmengen und Kundenzufriedenheit.
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle: - Abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium in einer technischen Disziplin. - Vorherige Erfahrung in einer Koordinierung

Nous recherchons un spécialiste des ventes techniques passionné pour rejoindre notre équipe marketing et ventes à Zurich, en Suisse.
• Vos responsabilités : - Identifier de manière proactive de nouvelles opportunités commerciales et développer notre clientèle - Servir de point de contact principal pour toutes les questions spécifiques à vos comptes - Établir et entretenir des relations clients solides et durables - Développer des opportunités de vente en tirant parti de nos réussites - Comprendre en profondeur les besoins des clients et en tirer une proposition de valeur convaincante pour nos solutions Visual SLAM - Coordonner les demandes commerciales avec nos gestionnaires de comptes - Concentrer vos activités sur notre solution de suivi des chariots élévateurs : identifier les acteurs clés et leurs besoins et générer des prospects pour augmenter les ventes dans ce domaine. - Soutenir les évaluations et les intégrations de produits en étroite collaboration avec nos ingénieurs d'application et nos chefs de projet, garantissant ainsi des volumes de ventes élevés et la satisfaction des clients.
• Qualifications pour le rôle : - Diplôme universitaire complété dans une discipline technique - Expérience antérieure dans un poste de coordination

jobs.title: (80 -100%) Engineering Team Leader
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Business Line MV Drives Service Operations Manager

__

As Engineering Team Leader, you will lead and develop a multidisciplinary team of engineers supporting modernization and upgrade projects for medium voltage drives within Motion Service Switzerland.

You will be responsible for delivering high-quality, cost-effective, and timely engineering solutions while ensuring efficient resource planning, team development, and achievement of contractual and financial targets. Working closely with Project Management, Field Service, and Sales, you will drive technical excellence, operational efficiency, and continuous improvement across engineering activities.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Lead, coach, and develop a multidisciplinary engineering team of electrical, mechanical, and software engineers, ensuring effective resource planning and capability development
  • Deliver high-quality engineering solutions for modernization and upgrade projects, ensuring compliance with customer, safety, cybersecurity, quality, schedule, and cost requirements
  • Collaborate closely with Project Management, Field Service, Supply Chain, and other stakeholders to ensure successful project execution and installation activities
  • Provide technical leadership, feasibility assessments, and engineering support during the sales and bid phases
  • Drive continuous improvement, technical excellence, risk management, and the implementation of ABB values, HSE, integrity, and compliance standards

• Qualifications for the role:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering or related field (Master’s preferred)
  • Minimum 5 years of professional experience in engineering
  • Strong background in power electronics
  • Experience in service / modernization projects (retrofits, upgrades)
  • Proven leadership experience (managing 2–6+ engineers). Strong technical understanding of electrical and mechanical engineering processes
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work collaboratively with Project Management and Field Service team
  • Fluent in English; German preferred

Additional Information

Occasional travel (<10%) within the operational network (e.g., Finland, Poland, USA)

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie mit, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Business Line MV Drives Service Operations Manager

Als Engineering Team Leader leiten und entwickeln Sie ein multidisziplinäres Team von Ingenieuren, das Modernisierungs- und Upgrade-Projekte für Mittelspannungsantriebe innerhalb von Motion Service Switzerland unterstützt.

Sie sind dafür verantwortlich, qualitativ hochwertige, kostengünstige und zeitnahe Engineering-Lösungen zu liefern und gleichzeitig eine effiziente Ressourcenplanung, Teamentwicklung und das Erreichen vertraglicher und finanzieller Ziele zu gewährleisten. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Projektmanagement, Außendienst und Vertrieb werden Sie technische Exzellenz, betriebliche Effizienz und kontinuierliche Verbesserung in allen Engineering-Aktivitäten vorantreiben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für:

  • Führen, coachen und entwickeln Sie ein multidisziplinäres Engineering-Team von Elektro-, Mechanik- und Software-Ingenieuren, um eine effektive Ressourcenplanung und Fähigkeitsentwicklung zu gewährleisten
  • Bereitstellung qualitativ hochwertiger Engineering-Lösungen für Modernisierungs- und Upgrade-Projekte, um die Einhaltung der Kunden-, Sicherheits-, Cybersicherheits-, Qualitäts-, Zeitplan- und Kostenanforderungen zu gewährleisten
  • Zusammenarbeit eng mit Projektmanagement, Außendienst, Supply Chain und anderen Stakeholdern, um erfolgreiche Projektausführungs- und Installationsaktivitäten sicherzustellen
  • Technische Führung, Machbarkeitsbewertungen und technische Unterstützung während der Verkaufs- und Gebotsphase anbieten
  • Steigende Verbesserung, technische Exzellenz, Risikomanagement und die Umsetzung von ABB-Werten, HSE, Integrität und Compliance-Standards

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle:

  • Bachelor-Abschluss in Elektrotechnik, Maschinenbau oder verwandten Bereichen (Master bevorzugt)
    • Mindest 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung im IngenieurwesenStarker Hintergrund in Leistungselektronik
  • Erfahrung in Service / ModernisierungProjekten (Retrofits, Upgrades)
    • Nachgewiesene Führungserfahrung (Manage von 2-6+ Ingenieuren). Starkes technisches Verständnis von Elektro- und Maschinenbauprozessen
  • Exzellentes Kommunikations- und Stakeholdermanagement
    • Fluent in English Preferred

Zusätzliche Informationen

Occasional Travel (<10%) innerhalb des operativen Netzwerks (z. B. Finnland, Polen, USA)

Der Aufbau einer saubereren, intelligenteren Zukunft erfordert alle Arten von Köpfen: das Neugierige, das Mutige und das Kreative. Deshalb begrüßen wir Menschen mit allen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen.

Ready to make a impact?

Bewerben Sie sich noch heute oder besuchen Sie https://www.abb.com, um mehr über die Auswirkungen unserer Lösungen auf der ganzen Welt zu erfahren.

Business Line MV Drives Service Operations Manager

En tant que chef d'équipe de l'ingénierie, vous dirigerez et développerez une équipe multidisciplinaire d'ingénieurs appuyant des projets de modernisation et de mise à niveau de lecteurs à moyenne tension dans Motion Service Suisse.

Vous serez responsable de fournir des solutions d'ingénierie de haute qualité, rentable et opportune tout en assurant une planification efficace des ressources, le développement d'équipes et la réalisation des objectifs contractuels et financiers.   • Minimum 5 années d'expérience professionnelle en génie
  • Fond d'expérience dans électronique de puissance
  • Expérience dans service/modernisationprojets (rétrofits, mises à niveau)
    • Expérience de leadership éprouvée (gestion de 2 à 6 ingénieurs). Une bonne compréhension technique des processus de génie électrique et mécanique
  • Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des intervenants
  • Possibilité de travailler en collaboration avec l'équipe de gestion de projet et du Service mobile
  • Fluent in AllemandPresté

Travel (<10 %) au sein du réseau opérationnel (par exemple, Finlande, Pologne, États-Unis)
