This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

Senior Key Account Manager


At the Sevensense office in Zurich, we push the frontiers of Visual SLAM and build the eyes and brains for ABB’s mobile robots. Our real-time tracking solutions provide warehouses and factories with instant visibility into their forklift traffic, utilization, and safety. We’re looking for a passionate Technical Account Manager to join our Marketing & Sales team in Zurich, Switzerland.

Your mission:

  • Manage a sales area with a focus on our forklift tracking solution: identify key players and their needs, and generate leads to grow the sales in your area

  • Proactively identify new business opportunities and grow the customer base

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for all matters specific to your accounts:

    • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting customer relationships

    • Develop sales opportunities by leveraging our success stories

    • Deeply understand the customer needs and derive a compelling value proposition for our Visual SLAM solutions

    • Quote, invoice, forecast, report, and negotiate contracts independently growing revenue and profit

  • Coordinate and influence external and internal stakeholders (technical, managerial, executive) throughout the customer journey to secure high sales volumes and customer satisfaction

Your background:

  • 3-5 years of work experience in technical sales or project management

  • Analytical attitude with outstanding presentation and communication skills, in particular in situations of conflict and negotiations

jobs.title: Senior Robotic Middleware Software Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This role sits within ABB's Robotics business, a leading global robotics company. We're entering an exciting new chapter as we’ve announced the plan for SoftBank Group to acquire ABB Robotics. SoftBank is a globally recognized technology group and investor/operator focused on AI, robotics, and next-generation computing. By joining us now, you’ll be part of a pioneering team shaping the future of robotics—working alongside world-class experts in a fast-moving, innovation-driven environment.

This Position reports to:

R&D Team Lead


In this role, you will act as a key technical contributor to the base software platform of our products. You will apply your expertise to make sure our algorithms are supplied with fresh sensor data and can run without interruptions, even in the toughest conditions. Your work will glue all pieces of software together and make our robots operate robustly in real-world environments.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-hybrid


This role is contributing to the Sevensense by ABB team as part of ABB Robotics in Switzerland and Spain. You will work closely with all software teams at Sevensense to make sure our algorithms reliably execute on our own hardware products.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Designing and implementing the robotics middleware that connects all our sensors and algorithms together.

  • Making sure your fellow developers have the tools to record, visualize and introspect our robotic systems.

  • Ensuring a healthy robot system that can be easily debugged across releases.

  • Improving the stability and reliability of our robots such that they can work 24/7 without interruption to make our customers happy.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • 5+ years of experience in Software Engineering and a degree in Computer Science, Robotics or related field.

  • Track record in writing solid production Python and C++ code and bonus points for Rust or the willingness to learn Rust.

  • Familiarity with robotic middleware like ROS2 or equivalent, and a passion for internal robot software architecture.

  • Deep expertise in real-time systems and knowing how to trace/profile them, additionally you have a good understanding of embedded Linux.

  • Ability to solve complex technical problems independently, taking ownership in a product-driven environment, and collaborating effectively across teams.

  • Bonus points for working with Nvidia Jetson modules, and the application of them in diverse robot setups.

What's in it for you?

You will join a team of highly talented, motivated, and collaborative professionals based in Zurich, Switzerland and Sant Quirze del Vallès (Barcelona). Working alongside experienced engineers with deep expertise in robotics, embedded systems, and distributed software, you will have continuous opportunities to learn and develop your skills. As part of this team, you will play a key role in building a robust foundation for our mobile robots. Together, we push the boundaries of autonomous mobile robots, working with modern middleware, real-time systems, and advanced hardware. You will have the opportunity to design and improve systems that power a large fleet of robots operating in real-world environments, going beyond simulations and prototypes to deliver reliable, production-ready solutions.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Sie sind hauptsächlich verantwortlich für: - Design und Implementierung der Robotik-Middleware, die alle unsere Sensoren und Algorithmen miteinander verbindet. Stellen Sie sicher, dass Ihre Mitentwickler über die Werkzeuge verfügen, um unsere Robotersysteme aufzuzeichnen, zu visualisieren und zu untersuchen. Sicherstellen eines gesunden Robotersystems, das über Releases hinweg leicht debuggt werden kann. - Verbesserung der Stabilität und Zuverlässigkeit unserer Roboter, so dass sie 24/7 ohne Unterbrechung arbeiten können, um unsere Kunden glücklich zu machen.
• Qualifikationen für die Rolle: - 5 + Jahre Erfahrung in Software Engineering und a d egree in Informatik, Robotik oder verwandten Bereich . - Track Record im Schreiben solide Produktion Python und C ++ Code und Bonuspunkte für Rust oder die Bereitschaft, Rust zu lernen. Vertrautheit mit Roboter-Middleware wie ROS2 oder gleichwertig und eine Leidenschaft für interne Roboter-Software-Architektur. - Deep e xper tise in Echtzeit-Systemen und zu wissen, wie man sie verfolgt / profiliert, zusätzlich haben Sie ein Verständnis von Embedded Linux. - Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Probleme selbstständig zu lösen, Verantwortung in einer produktorientierten Umgebung zu übernehmen und teamübergreifend effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten. - Bonuspunkte für die Arbeit mit N vidia Jetson Modulen und deren Anwendung in verschiedenen Roboter-Setups. Was ist für dich drin? Sie werden einem Team von hochtalentierten, motivierten und kooperativen Fachleuten mit Sitz in Zürich, Schweiz und Sant Quirze del Vallès (Barcelona) beitreten. In Zusammenarbeit mit erfahrenen Ingenieuren mit fundiertem Fachwissen in Robotik, eingebetteten Systemen und verteilter Software haben Sie kontinuierliche Möglichkeiten, Ihre Fähigkeiten zu erlernen und zu entwickeln. Als Teil dieses Teams werden Sie eine Schlüsselrolle beim Aufbau einer robusten Grundlage für unsere mobilen Roboter spielen. Gemeinsam erweitern wir die Grenzen autonomer mobiler Roboter und arbeiten mit moderner Middleware, Echtzeitsystemen und fortschrittlicher Hardware. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, Systeme zu entwerfen und zu verbessern, die eine große Flotte von Robotern betreiben, die in realen Umgebungen arbeiten und über Simulationen und Prototypen hinausgehen, um zuverlässige, produktionsfähige Lösungen zu liefern. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela arrive. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grit. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Courez ce qui dirige le monde. Ce rôle fait partie de l'activité Robotics d'ABB, une entreprise de robotique mondiale de premier plan. Nous entrons dans un nouveau chapitre passionnant alors que nous avons annoncé le projet de SoftBank Group d'acquérir ABB Robotics. SoftBank est un groupe technologique mondialement reconnu et un investisseur/exploitant axé sur l'IA, la robotique et l'informatique de prochaine génération. En vous joignant à nous maintenant, vous ferez partie d'une équipe pionnière qui façonnera l'avenir de la robotique, travaillant aux côtés d'experts de calibre mondial dans un environnement en évolution rapide et axé sur l'innovation. Ce poste relève de : Chef d'équipe de R-D Dans ce rôle, vous serez un contributeur technique clé à la plate-forme logicielle de base de nos produits. Vous appliquerez votre expertise pour vous assurer que nos algorithmes sont fournis avec de nouvelles données de capteur et peuvent fonctionner sans interruption, même dans les conditions les plus difficiles. Votre travail va coller tous les logiciels ensemble et faire fonctionner nos robots de manière robuste dans des environnements réels. Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est hybride. #L-hybride Ce rôle contribue à l'équipe de Sevensense d'ABB dans le cadre de l'ABB Robotics in S witzerland and S pain . Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec toutes les équipes logicielles de Sevensense pour vous assurer que nos algorithmes s'exécutent de manière fiable sur nos propres produits matériels. Vous serez principalement responsable : - de concevoir et de mettre en œuvre l'intergiciel robotique qui relie tous nos capteurs et algorithmes ensemble. - S'assurer que vos collègues développeurs ont les outils pour enregistrer, visualiser et introduire nos systèmes robotiques. - Assurer un système robotisé sain qui peut être facilement débrouillé à travers les rejets. - Améliorer la stabilité et la fiabilité de nos robots afin qu'ils puissent fonctionner 24/7 sans interruption pour rendre nos clients heureux.
• Qualifications pour le rôle: - 5 ans d'expérience en génie logiciel et d'expérience en informatique, robotique ou domaine connexe . - Track record in writing solide production Code Python et C++ et points bonus pour Rust ou la volonté d'apprendre Rust. - Familiarité avec les intergiciels robotiques comme ROS2 ou équivalent, et passion pour l'architecture interne du logiciel robot. - Deep e xper tise dans les systèmes en temps réel et sachant les tracer / les profiler, vous avez en outre une bonne compréhension de Linux intégré. - Capacité de résoudre les problèmes techniques complexes de façon indépendante, de s'approprier un environnement axé sur les produits et de collaborer efficacement entre les équipes. - Points bonus pour travailler avec les modules N vidia Jetson , et l'application de ceux-ci dans diverses configurations de robots. Qu'est-ce qui te prend ? Vous rejoindrez une équipe de professionnels hautement talentueux, motivés et collaboratifs basés à Zurich, Suisse et Sant Quirze del Vallès (Barcelone). En travaillant avec des ingénieurs expérimentés possédant une expertise approfondie en robotique, systèmes embarqués et logiciels distribués, vous aurez des occasions continues d'apprendre et de développer vos compétences. Dans le cadre de cette équipe, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans la construction d'une base solide pour nos robots mobiles. Ensemble, nous repoussons les frontières des robots mobiles autonomes, en travaillant avec des intergiciels modernes, des systèmes en temps réel et du matériel avancé. Vous aurez la possibilité de concevoir et d'améliorer des systèmes qui alimentent une grande flotte de robots opérant dans des environnements réels, allant au-delà des simulations et des prototypes pour fournir des solutions fiables et prêtes à la production. Nous apprécions les gens de différents horizons. Ça pourrait être votre histoire ? Faites une demande aujourd'hui ou visitez www.abb.com pour en savoir plus sur nous et découvrez l'impact de nos solutions à travers le monde.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer (80-100 %)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Senior Project Lead Engineer

__

B&R sets global standards for perfect automation and digitalization.

We are an internationally established automation company and put all our knowledge, our long-standing experience, and creativity into our products, whose innovative power is pioneering. This is made possible by the many constructive ideas of our employees – they are the basis for our shared results. Modern working practices, an open communication culture, and career opportunities at home and abroad distinguish us as an employer.

Groundbreakings are the current innovations in the areas of visualization, robotics, and mechatronic systems, which round off B&R's performance portfolio for the digitalized future of machinery and plant engineering and open unprecedented possibilities for machinery and plant engineers from all industries.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly responsible for:

  • Development of concepts and application software for machine automation.

  • Support of customers with commissioning, system optimization, and technical support.

  • Conducting training and sharing know-how with customers and colleagues.

  • Development into a technical specialist and support of sales as well as customers with your own knowledge.



What we’re looking for:

  • Technical vocational training and further education as an engineer FH / technician HF in electrical engineering, systems engineering, mechanical engineering, or equivalent

  • Experience with common programming languages (IEC 61131-3 (structured text), ANSI C)

  • Knowledge in the areas of CNC, robotics, vision, IoT, and cyber security

  • Enjoyment of direct customer contact and collaboration in a collaborative team

  • Motivation, solution-oriented approach, and networked thinking

  • Fluent French and English language skills

  • Willingness to travel within Switzerland

More about us:
B&R Industry Automation AG, headquartered in Frauenfeld, is the Swiss subsidiary of the Austrian innovative automation company B&R Industrial Automation GmbH with headquarters in Austria and offices worldwide. B&R is a business unit of ABB. As an industry leader in industrial automation, B&R combines cutting-edge technologies with advanced engineering. B&R provides customers from various industries with perfect comprehensive solutions in machine and factory automation, drive and control technology, visualization, and integrated safety technology.

This recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner Switzerland.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Project Lead Engineer (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to act as the technical lead for traction system customer projects. Each day, you will ensure the activities related to all engineering disciplines within the project are executed in an efficient and cost-effective manner. You will also showcase your expertise by acting as a technical design authority for complete projects and drive the corresponding design and engineering activities.

The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Motion Business - Traction Division. Main stakeholders are product management, project management, R&D and production.

You will be mainly accountable for:
  • Technical lead of the project team of specialist engineers for complex engineering projects, in collaboration with the commercial project manager
  • Technical representation of the project towards the customer and suppliers
  • Ensuring project execution within the given time, cost, and scope framework
  • Drive decisions and maintain close collaboration with other engineering teams (locally and globally), R&D, product management, project management and other relevant functions
  • Actively promoting the application and continuous improvement of engineering practices and processes

Our team dynamics
You will join a high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.

• Qualifications for the role
  • Bachelor, Master or PhD in electrical, software or mechanical engineering
  • At least 5 years work experience in a technical customer focused area, ideally in the field of railway, E-bus or heavy electric vehicle propulsion
  • Technical Project management experience
  • Strong level of self-motivation, curiosity, and a structured approach to work
  • Team player with excellent communication skills in English and preferably in German
Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:
  • Canteen
  • Flexible work practices
  • on-site Gym

jobs.title: Service Sales Specialist (80-100%)
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Service Sales Manager

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to develop service sales, from lead generation, service sales opportunities creation until securing the profitable sales within the designated areas. Each day, you will focus on Installed Base (IB) and sell the entire Service portfolio. You will also showcase your skills by building long-term customer relationships and ensuring immediate response to specific customer needs and issues.

The work model for the role is hybrid.

This role contributes to the Service of Mining and Materials Business Line within the Automation Process Industries division in a defined global region.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Penetrating into IB, promoting various upgrades, retrofits, and value-add services to the benefit of the customers and ABB.
  • Understanding the channel strategy and the establishment of related prices, preparing sales plans, reviewing them, and proposing recovery plan(s) when needed.
  • Generating service sales leads and developing new market opportunities by utilizing market trend information and through identifying and exploring potential new service portfolios.
  • Acting as a marketer/salesperson of ABB’s service products and solutions during marketing activities (campaigns, trade fairs, exhibitions, conferences, customer meetings).


Our team dynamics
You will join an international collaborative team working in a changing business environment, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role

  • Degree in Engineering Disciplines or Business and 5+ years of experience in similar roles
  • You are highly motivated and enjoy working in agile market and you’re willing to travel up to 30%
  • Demonstrated experience in managing accounts, increasing sales growth, and complex negotiations
  • Solid stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work with cross-functional teams and customers
  • Solid data-driven pipeline & forecasting discipline (e.g., SFDC)
  • Proven tender/pursuit leadership up to complex, high-value solution deals
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in English; German and other languages are welcome

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:

  • Flexible working hours
  • Learning and growth opportunities
  • Career growth opportunities
  • Generous vacation allowance


More about us
We help the mining industry become safer, leaner, and more sustainable by combining electrification, automation, and digital technologies with over 130 years of experience.
Our comprehensive mining services portfolio - ranging from engineering and maintenance to digital and lifecycle solutions - supports customers in maximizing asset performance and availability.
Together with our customers, we deliver tailored, data-driven solutions that enable reliable operations today while shaping the future of the all-electric, connected mine.

The recruitment process is led by Ceren Özen, Talent Acquisition Partner, ABB Switzerland Ltd.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Engineering Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Mechanical Engineer in Traction, you are responsible for the mechanical design of converters, energy storage systems and cooling units for railway and heavy on or off-road applications. The products are used worldwide in rail vehicles, e-buses and e-trucks or construction machines. To strengthen this motivated team, we are looking for a committed and experienced mechanical design engineer with interest in power electronics.


The work model for the role is: hybrid

This role is contributing to the Rail Systems Business Line in Untersiggenthal.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Mechanical engineering and design of complete converters and cooling units

  • Create, maintain, and manage product data within PLM systems (Product Lifecycle Management)

  • Plan and perform validation tests, particularly for cooling performance and structural strength

  • Support production during the introduction of new products and contribute to product maintenance and continuous improvement.

  • Create technical specifications and clarify technical requirements with suppliers and customers

  • Support the sales organization during the concept development and quotation phase


You will join a dynamic and high performing team, where you will be able to thrive.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Trained and experienced Mechanical Design Engineer with further technical school (TS), or bachelor’s /master’s degree in mechanical engineering.

  • Experience with CAD and ERP systems, ideally Creo and PTC Windchill

  • Solid English skills, German is preferred

  • Open, collaborative team player with a hands-on and approachable working style

  • Applications from early-career professionals and motivated graduates are also welcome.

  • Preferably experienced in the design of power electronic equipment for rolling stock, automotive, or other vehicle applications

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: (80 - 100%) Engineering Change Manager Service
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Principal Technical Support Engineer

__

In this role, you will have the opportunity to ensure that change notifications by the Agile teams of the UPS product lines consider the serviceability of the products. You will engage with the change managers of the Agile teams and the stakeholders within Service on a daily basis.

This role contributes to the Global Service Engineering team in Quartino. The main stakeholders include change managers from the Agile teams of the UPS product lines in Quartino, service professionals responsible for technical support, documentation, and spare parts, as well as supply chain specialists responsible for spare part creation and stock management.

You will join a newly formed Service Engineering team, where you will have the opportunity to thrive.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Analyzing new ECN (engineering change notices) for potential impact on Service
  • Maintaining a tracker for ECN potentially affecting Service
  • Run the meetings where Service stakeholders discuss ECN impact and suggest changes to the change leaders
  • Track the updates to the ECN based on Service stakeholder consensus and approve acceptable ECN
  • Track the execution of Service implementation of the ECN (Service News, Spare part (list) updates, information to global technical support)
  • Providing technical support and solving problems in own expertise area via remote or on-site service in any Service category
  • You will support the change managers pro-actively to improve the correctness, completeness, and effectiveness of the Service aspects of the ECN

• Qualifications for the role:

  • A bachelor’s degree, diploma, or higher academic qualification in Electrical or Electronic Engineering
  • At least 5 years of experience in similar roles, or 10 years of experience in UPS development or service roles
  • Experience with the product lines manufactured in Quartino
  • Experience with change management process and related documentation
  • Experience in the Windchill change management system
  • Proficiency in both verbal and written English communication (B2 level or higher) Knowledge of any other language is a welcome asset

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Sales Manager - Switzerland

__

Your role and responsibilities

As a Front-End Sales Engineer, it is your exciting task to implement our sales strategy and to distribute our products and solutions to customers in Switzerland. In close cooperation with our internal service, you consult and convince customers of the benefits of our high-performance products. In addition to looking after existing customers, you are also responsible for the acquisition of new clients. You will systematically conclude contracts with business partners and thus contribute to a sustainable increase in our company's market share.


The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid


This role is contributing to the ABB Motors & Drives division in Switzerland.

  • Leading project tendering activities by identifying, qualifying, and actively pursuing project opportunities; coordinating internal stakeholders (engineering, product management, and service) to deliver competitive and compliant technical and commercial proposals
  • Influencing engineering companies and key decision-makers early in the project lifecycle to position ABB solutions as the preferred specification, ensuring alignment with customer technical requirements and long-term value propositions
  • Building strong customer relationships by understanding needs and offering tailored ABB solutions, while leading technical and commercial contract negotiations
  • Tracking market trends, identifying new opportunities, and managing sales processes and documentation, including account plans and SFDC reporting

• Qualifications for the role

  • University degree or diploma of higher education (TS/HF) in a technical field
  • In-depth technical knowledge of motors, generators, drives, and services
  • Demonstrated experience in the management of customer accounts and sales strategy with proven ability to develop and maintain customer relationships
  • Market and customer knowledge are a plus
  • A collaborative, solutions-oriented approach and strong communication skills
  • Availability for travel throughout Switzerland, but mainly in the German-speaking part
  • Fluent in German and English, other languages are an advantage

Benefits
We also offer our employees the following benefits:


  • Employee share acquisition plan (ESAP)
  • REKA credit
  • Employee discounts (MyDiscounts / Swibeco)

ABB Motors and Drives delivers a complete range of motors, generators and drive products for all industries and applications. Our mission is to be an expert in automated industrial systems, to focus on reliability in our partnerships, and to know our customers’ requirements by heart.

__

In this role within the Customer Project Execution Team, you will conduct customer witnessed testing and verification activities for assignments of medium/high testing complexity of systems,
subsystems, or products effectively and cost-efficiently and in accordance with contract specifications, quality standards, safety requirements, and cybersecurity policies and standards.

  • Native Italian speaker with strong English (B1) communication skills; able to interact confidently and professionally with customers and internal stakeholders in an international environment.

  • Vous faites preuve d’autonomie, de flexibilité et d’une forte orientation client

  • Excellentes compétences en communication en français et en anglais (l’allemand est un atout)

  • Vous êtes passionné(e) par l’analyse et la sélection de stratégies commerciales et de solutions en fonction des besoins clients

  • Bonne maîtrise des calculs de coûts et de la structuration d’offres techniques

  • Vous possédez un esprit d’équipe, de la fiabilité et une grande intégrité professionnelle



    Your role and responsibilities

    In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (division and market) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your expertise by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.
    The work model for the role is: hybrid.
    This role is contributing to the Medium Voltage Switchgear business within the Electrification Distribution Solutions division in Switzerland.

    You will be mainly accountable for

    • Coordinating quote requests and deadlines as well as conducting procurement negotiations with suppliers during the tendering phase

    • Analyzing and evaluating requests, specifications and tenders from technical and commercial perspectives

    • Defining sales strategies and designing product configurations based on customer requirements in collaboration with sales, engineering and project management

    • Creating commercial and technical quote documentation, including detailed description of products and services

    • Qualifications for the role

    • You hold a degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering field, or a higher professional qualification in engineering (e.g. Höhere Fachschule, Fachhochschule)

    • You are captivated by independent, flexible and customer-oriented working style

    • You are at ease communicating in French and English (German is an advantage)

    • You are passionate about finding the right sales strategies and products based on customer needs

    • Proven experience of cost calculations

    • You are a reliable team player and personality with integrity

​More about us

ABB's Distribution Solutions division provides medium voltage components, switchgear, and solutions that connect and protect the evolving electrical grid, ensuring reliable and predictable energy distribution. We link high-voltage systems to medium and low-voltage consumers, ensuring continuous power delivery to industrial, commercial, and residential users while enabling the integration of renewable energy sources into the grid. Our smart solutions, powered by AI, enhance grid resilience and optimize the usage of the electrical system.

With ABB Ability™ enabled connected solutions, the offering includes medium-voltage air- and gas-insulated switchgear (1 to 46 kilovolts), indoor and outdoor circuit breakers, protection relays, instrument transformers, sensors and solutions for distribution stations. We support our customers and partners in staying ahead of increasing electrification needs, technology, and regulatory changes, providing the power to adapt to a rapidly evolving energy landscape.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.title: R&D (Senior)Testing & Lab Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__

Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Own the lab infrastructure (Laborinfrastruktur), including coordination with maintenance (Instandhaltung), organizing calibration (Kalibrierung) of equipment, and managing lab supplies (Verbrauchsmaterialien).
  • Ensure lab safety (Sicherheit) and organize/structure lab spaces for multiple ongoing projects.
  • Support scientific work by designing and building power electronics prototypes (Leistungselektronik Prototypen) up to medium voltage (Mittelspannung) and megawatt power.
  • Assist in commissioning test setups (Inbetriebnahme von Prüfaufbauten) and perform testing together with scientific staff (Wissenschaftler).
  • Collaborate closely with internal and external stakeholders (Teamfähigkeit), and supervise apprentices (Lernende / Auszubildende) in daily tasks.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Completed apprenticeship as an automation technician (Automatiker EFZ) with practical experience in machining (Fräsen, Bohren, Drehen, Handarbeit), and be able to conversate in English.
  • Additional education from a Higher Technical School or University of Applied Sciences (Höhere Fachschule HF / Fachhochschule FH) in power electronics, energy systems, or similar is a strong advantage.
  • Experience with CAD design (CAD-Konstruktion) using tools such as Creo, Solid Edge, SolidWorks, or equivalent; PCB design (Leiterplattendesign) knowledge is a plus (Altium Designer).
  • Solid experience in electrical circuit design (Schaltungsdesign), grounding concepts (Erdung), and wiring standards (Verdrahtungsrichtlinien).
  • Hands-on experience building and prototyping power electronic systems (Leistungselektronik Systeme), including mechanical work, tooling (Werkzeuge), and implementing ad-hoc improvements.
  • Basic knowledge of electrical standards (e.g., NIV / NIN / SNR 464022) and familiarity with lab technologies such as 3D printing (3D-Druck), LabVIEW, and laser cutting/engraving (Laserschneider / Lasergravur).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. That's why we welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

Ready to make an impact?

Apply today or visit https://www.abb.com to learn more about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

Procurement Manager

__

Your role and responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to gain vocational experience through a temporary work placement. Each day, you will acquire knowledge by performing tasks as directed. You will also showcase your skills by supporting ABB’s operations and enhancing personal education/employment opportunities

The work model for the role is: #LI-onsite

This role is contributing to Procurement team in Schaffhausen, Switzerland. Main stakeholders are Electrification Division.

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Manage sub projects in sourcing and benchmarking activities
  • Support the local Power User with our eProcurement tools
  • Assist and support in process optimization
  • Report on price development and market intelligence
  • Master Data correction actions & document management
  • External supplier correspondence and KPI tracking and reporting
  • Organize and prepare supplier visits and audits

• Qualifications for the role

  • Currently pursuing a Bachelor or Master degree in economics, engineering, information systems or similar with first supply chain experience
  • Fluent in German and English
  • Confidential handling of MS Excel
  • Good communication skills; shows initiative, self-managing, and well-organized working behavior
  • Curiosity and initiative
  • SAP knowledge is a plus
  • You hold a current valid VISA/work permit for Switzerland or a confirmation for a mandatory internship from your university

More about us

ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

We look forward to receiving your application. The recruiting process is led by Talent Partner Mara Werne. If you would like to learn more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com.

jobs.title: R&D (Senior) Scientist - Medium Voltage High Power Magnetics
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This position reports to:

R&D Team Lead

__


Your role and responsibilities

The mission of this team is to bring modern and disruptive power electronic solutions from research into product development. We improve our products by holistic optimization, pushing forward novel converter topologies as well as optimizing key components. By joining us, you will participate in idea generation at the frontier of academic research and industrial applications, as well as in the development of advanced technologies for ABB’s products.

Do you want to contribute to a greener future by utilizing advanced and highly efficient power-electronic solutions for various applications? Get in touch with us! A young, multinational team is looking forward to welcoming you as their latest team member!

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Develop low- to medium-frequency, high-power magnetic components with medium-voltage insulation for emerging power electronics applications.
  • Generate innovative concepts at the intersection of power electronics and magnetics.
  • Plan, set up, and execute experimental characterization, including model validation of magnetic components.
  • Contribute your expertise to research projects and translate results into patent applications, scientific publications, and technical reports.
  • Build and maintain a professional network within the organization, actively sharing knowledge and fostering collaboration.

• Qualifications for the role

  • Ph.D. in electrical engineering, power electronics, physics, or a related field.
  • Excellent scientific publication record in high-impact journals and leading power electronics conferences.
  • Expertise in designing medium-frequency transformers with medium-voltage insulation.
  • Experience with magnetic core materials and winding technologies (e.g., Litz wire, foil) across low to high frequency ranges.
  • Strong modeling capabilities for magnetic components, including electromagnetic simulations and thermal management.
  • Proven hands-on laboratory experience in testing and characterization, with a solid foundation in power electronics and fluency in English (written and spoken).

More about us

At the ABB research center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

descriptionByLocale.de:
At ABB helfen wir Industrien, schlanker und sauberer zu laufen - und jeder Mensch hier macht das möglich. Sie werden in der Lage sein zu führen, unterstützt zu wachsen und stolz auf die Wirkung, die wir gemeinsam schaffen. Begleiten Sie uns und helfen Sie dabei, was die Welt beherrscht.


Diese Position berichtet an:

R&D Team Lead


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Mission dieses Teams ist es, moderne und disruptive leistungselektronische Lösungen aus der Forschung in die Produktentwicklung zu bringen. Wir verbessern unsere Produkte durch ganzheitliche Optimierung, die Weiterentwicklung neuartiger Konvertertopologien sowie die Optimierung von Schlüsselkomponenten. Indem Sie sich uns anschließen, beteiligen Sie sich an der Ideengenerierung an der Grenze der akademischen Forschung und der industriellen Anwendungen sowie an der Entwicklung fortschrittlicher Technologien für die Produkte von ABB.

Möchten Sie durch den Einsatz fortschrittlicher und hocheffizienter leistungselektronischer Lösungen für verschiedene Anwendungen zu einer grüneren Zukunft beitragen? Kontaktieren Sie uns! Ein junges, multinationales Team freut sich darauf, Sie als sein neuestes Teammitglied willkommen zu heißen!

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Die Hauptaufgaben umfassen

  • Entwickeln Sie nieder- bis mittelfrequente, leistungsstarke magnetische Komponenten mit Mittelspannungsisolierung für neue Leistungselektronikanwendungen.
  • Erzeugen Sie innovative Konzepte an der Schnittstelle von Leistungselektronik und Magnetik.
  • Planen, Einrichten und Ausführen der experimentellen Charakterisierung, einschließlich Modellvalidierung von magnetischen Komponenten.
  • Bringen Sie Ihre Expertise in Forschungsprojekte ein und übersetzen Sie die Ergebnisse in Patentanmeldungen, wissenschaftliche Publikationen und technische Berichte.
  • Aufbau und Pflege eines professionellen Netzwerks innerhalb der Organisation, aktiver Wissensaustausch und Förderung der Zusammenarbeit.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • Ph.D. in Elektrotechnik, Leistungselektronik, Physik oder einem verwandten Bereich.
  • Exzellente wissenschaftliche Publikation in renommierten Zeitschriften und führenden Konferenzen der Leistungselektronik.
  • Expertise in der Entwicklung von Mittelfrequenztransformatoren mit Mittelspannungsisolierung.
  • Erfahrung mit magnetischen Kernmaterialien und Wicklungstechnologien (z. B. Litzdraht, Folie) in niedrigen bis hohen Frequenzbereichen.
  • Starke Modellierungsmöglichkeiten für magnetische Komponenten, einschließlich elektromagnetischer Simulationen und Wärmemanagement.
  • Bewährte praktische Laborerfahrung im Testen und Charakterisieren, mit einer soliden Basis in Leistungselektronik und fließend Englisch (geschrieben und gesprochen).

Mehr über uns

Im ABB-Forschungszentrum in Baden-Dättwil bei Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte prägen. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Leistungselektronik, Energiespeicherung, intelligente Systeme und Switching.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

À ABB, nous aidons les industries à fonctionner plus minces et plus propres. Vous aurez le pouvoir de diriger, de soutenir la croissance et d'être fiers de l'impact que nous créons ensemble. Joignez-vous à nous et aidez à exécuter ce qui dirige le monde.

Cette position se rapporte à:

R&D Team Lead


Votre rôle et vos responsabilités

La mission de cette équipe est d'apporter des solutions électroniques modernes et perturbatrices de la recherche au développement de produits. Nous améliorons nos produits par l'optimisation holistique, en poussant de nouvelles topologies de convertisseur et en optimisant les composants clés. En vous joignant à nous, vous participerez à la génération d'idées à la frontière de la recherche universitaire et des applications industrielles, ainsi qu'au développement de technologies de pointe pour les produits ABB.

Vous voulez contribuer à un avenir plus écologique en utilisant des solutions électriques et électroniques avancées et très efficaces pour diverses applications? Contactez-nous ! Une jeune équipe multinationale est impatiente de vous accueillir comme leur dernier membre de l'équipe!

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est: #LI-Hybrid

Les principales responsabilités comprennent

  • Développer des composants magnétiques à basse et moyenne fréquence avec une isolation à moyenne tension pour les applications électroniques de puissance émergentes.
  • Générer des concepts novateurs à l'intersection de l'électronique de puissance et de l'électronique magnétique.
  • Planifier, mettre en place et exécuter la caractérisation expérimentale, y compris la validation de modèles de composants magnétiques.
  • Apportez votre expertise aux projets de recherche et traduisez les résultats en demandes de brevet, publications scientifiques et rapports techniques.
  • Créer et maintenir un réseau professionnel au sein de l'organisation, partager activement les connaissances et favoriser la collaboration.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • Ph.D. en génie électrique, en électronique de puissance, en physique ou dans un domaine connexe.
  • Excellente publication scientifique dans des revues à fort impact et conférences sur l'électronique de puissance.
  • Expertise dans la conception de transformateurs à moyenne fréquence avec isolation à moyenne tension.
  • Expérience des matériaux de base magnétiques et des technologies d'enroulement (p. ex. fil Litz, feuille) sur des gammes de fréquences basses à élevées.
  • Capacités de modélisation solides pour les composants magnétiques, y compris les simulations électromagnétiques et la gestion thermique.
  • Expérience de laboratoire pratique éprouvée dans les essais et la caractérisation, avec une solide base en électronique de puissance et la fluidité en anglais (écrit et parlé).

Plus d'informations sur nous

Au centre de recherche ABB de Baden-Dättwil à proximité de Zurich, nous travaillons sur des technologies passionnantes qui façonnent l'avenir de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutation.

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Field Service Engineer


Your role and responsibilities

As a Service Engineer, you will execute service work on rolling stock and energy storing systems with low to medium complexity according to work instructions and in accordance with ABB standard processes, quality standards and safety guidelines. You will be in close cooperation with customers and other ABB teams, acting as the technical point while delivering quality and satisfying customer service.

Reporting to the Head of Field Service, you will be responsible for providing routine maintenance and on-site or remote technical support. The position involves approximately 50 days of domestic and 30 days of international travel, as you will be providing hands-on assistance at customer sites.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Performing service tasks like installation and commissioning of equipment, identifying technical problems, making analysis through remote or on-site activity in different service categories (installation and commissioning, routine maintenance, extensions, replacements etc.)
  • Consulting with and advising customers on the best service solutions in accordance with standard processes, procedures, and safety guidelines. Furthermore creating and maintaining strong relationships with customers, appreciating their needs, and providing specialist assistance and solutions
  • Coordinating and executing specialist projects through planning, meeting milestones and regular reviews
  • Troubleshooting simple equipment failure and making recommendations to avoid repeating the problem in the future. Identifying opportunities to develop new service applications, equipment and methods

• Qualifications for the role

  • Four years of experience in electrical work, testing, maintenance, or service, working as test- or commissioning engineer with power electronics or on electrical vehicles
  • Knowledge and hands-on experience in servicing, maintaining, commissioning and repairing of power electronic products
  • Ability to travel worldwide
  • Proven leadership skills, with a collaborative, solution-focused approach and strong written and spoken communication skills
  • A technician or engineer bachelor’s degree in electrotechnics
  • Required language skills are fluent German, French, and English

More about us

ABB Traction Division is a recognized leader in onboard propulsion technologies that drive innovation in rail, bus, and industrial vehicle electrification. A comprehensive range of high-performance and full lifecycle managed propulsion, auxiliary and energy storage solutions help improve energy efficiency and contribute to making transportation more sustainable. We all together make the difference for our customers every day. We look forward to receiving your application.

If you want to discover more about ABB, take another look at our website www.abb.com. ABB Data Privacy Statement: https://new.abb.com/privacy-notice/candidate

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Manager


Important remark: This position is open for ongoing talent sourcing; while we are not actively hiring for this role at the moment, we welcome applications to build our future talent pipeline.

Your role and responsibilities:

You will be responsible for sales of electrification, low voltage, and control products in the automation and machine manufacturing segment for the Swiss OEM market, ensuring growth in sales volumes and margins. Reporting to the Head of Sales OEM Electrification, you will leverage your expertise to build lasting customer relationships through outstanding service.

The work model for the role is: #hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Drive sales by managing existing accounts, acquiring new customers, and collaborating with marketing, technical support, and sales teams to develop sales plans and identify market opportunities.

  • Leverage your knowledge of customers’ applications and ABB solutions to address needs, focusing on digitalization, Industry 4.0, and energy efficiency, ensuring technical and financial accuracy.

  • Partner closely with ABB distribution channels to enhance customer journey and maintain precise customer data within the CRM system (Salesforce).

  • Continuously expand your technical expertise, monitor market trends, and apply diverse sales techniques such as value-based selling to maximize business success.


• Qualifications for the role:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in technical sales

  • Strong technical expertise in low voltage products, with a solid understanding of the Swiss industry and automation.

  • Proficiency in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems; experience with order development tools (ERP) is a plus.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and maintain strong customer relationships, paired with a collaborative, solution-oriented mindset.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with fluency in German and English; French is an advantage.

  • Technical qualification, preferably a bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical, or Mechanical Engineering.

  • Valid Swiss driver’s license and work authorization in Switzerland.


More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers,
low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

The recruitment is led by Reto Korstick at ABB Switzerland, Ltd.

A Future Opportunity
Please note that this position is part of our talent pipeline and not an active job opening at this time. By applying, you express your interest in future career opportunities with ABB.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to learn more about us and see the impact of our work across the globe.

At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems


Your role and responsibilities

Our team's mission is to drive innovations at the intersection of power electronic converters and microgrid integration, translating cutting-edge research into next-generation ABB products. We focus on converter operation, intelligent protection coordination, load sharing, and stabilizing control strategies. By joining us, you will shape the future of energy systems - generating pioneering ideas at the frontier of academic research and industrial innovation, while developing transformative technologies that power ABB's product portfolio.

Are you passionate about enabling a sustainable future through power converter-based distribution systems? We want to hear from you! A dynamic, international team is excited to welcome you as our newest member. Together, we will push boundaries and make a lasting impact on the energy transition.

The work model for the role is: #LI-Hybrid

The main responsibilities include

  • Pioneer innovative concepts in power electronic converter-based, low voltage and medium voltage, AC and DC distribution systems.
  • Conduct detailed simulations, algorithm development, and laboratory experiments and publish research findings and patent innovative solutions.
  • Collaborate with global, multidisciplinary teams of scientists at ABB Research.
  • Work closely with ABB business units to transition research into real-world applications, including data centers, integration of renewables, industrial electrification, e-mining, and marine systems.

• Qualifications for the role

  • PhD in Electrical Engineering with specialization in power electronics, power systems, or control.
  • Proven research excellence demonstrated through high-impact publications and patents.
  • Deep technical expertise in:
    - Power electronic converter topologies, modulation and control concepts
    - Interactions between converters, passive components, and protection devices
    - Microgrid modeling, optimization and stability analysis.
  • Hands-on laboratory skills with a proactive, self-driven approach to designing, building, and testing converter systems and protection schemes. Versatile skill set with the ability to bridge theory and practice across multiple technical domains.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced industrial research environment and deliver results.
  • Excellent communication skills in English, both written and verbal.

More about us

At the ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in the proximity of Zurich, we work on exciting technologies that shape the future of our products. Our international research teams focus on Power Electronics, Energy Storage, Intelligent Systems, and Switching.

We look forward to receiving your application.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Bei ABB helfen wir den Industrien zu entkommen - schlanker und sauberer. Hier ist Fortschritt eine Erwartung - für Sie, Ihr Team und die Welt. Als globaler Marktführer geben wir Ihnen, was Sie brauchen, um dies zu erreichen. Es wird nicht immer einfach sein, Wachstum braucht Körnung. Aber bei ABB wirst du nie alleine laufen. Führen Sie, was die Welt regiert.

Diese Position berichtet an:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems


Ihre Rolle und Verantwortlichkeiten

Die Mission unseres Teams ist es, Innovationen an der Schnittstelle von Leistungselektronikwandlern und Microgrid-Integration voranzutreiben und Spitzenforschung in ABB-Produkte der nächsten Generation zu übersetzen. Wir konzentrieren uns auf den Konverterbetrieb, intelligente Schutzkoordination, Lastverteilung und stabilisierende Regelstrategien. Indem Sie sich uns anschließen, gestalten Sie die Zukunft der Energiesysteme - erzeugen bahnbrechende Ideen an der Grenze der akademischen Forschung und der industriellen Innovation und entwickeln transformative Technologien, die das Produktportfolio von ABB stärken. Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, eine nachhaltige Zukunft durch umrichterbasierte Verteilungssysteme zu ermöglichen? Wir wollen von Ihnen hören! Ein dynamisches, internationales Team freut sich, Sie als unser neuestes Mitglied begrüßen zu dürfen. Gemeinsam werden wir Grenzen überschreiten und die Energiewende nachhaltig vorantreiben.

Das Arbeitsmodell für die Rolle lautet: #LI-Hybrid

Die Hauptverantwortungen umfassen

  • Pionier innovative Konzepte in leistungselektronischen Umrichtern, Niederspannungs- und Mittelspannungs-, Wechselstrom- und Gleichstromverteilungssystemen.
  • Führen Sie detaillierte Simulationen, Algorithmenentwicklung und Laborexperimente durch und veröffentlichen Sie Forschungsergebnisse und patentieren Sie innovative Lösungen.
  • Arbeiten Sie mit globalen, multidisziplinären Wissenschaftlerteams von ABB Research zusammen.
  • Arbeiten Sie eng mit ABB-Geschäftseinheiten zusammen, um die Transformationsforschung in reale Anwendungen zu lenken, einschließlich Rechenzentren, Integration erneuerbarer Energien, industrieller Elektrifizierung, E-Mining und mariner Systeme.

• Qualifikationen für die Rolle

  • PhD in Elektrotechnik mit Spezialisierung in Leistungselektronik, Energiesystemen oder Steuerung.
  • Bewährte Forschungsexzellenz, die durch einflussreiche Publikationen und Patente demonstriert wurde.
  • Deep technical expertise in:
    - Leistungselektronische Wandlertopologien, Modulations- und Steuerungskonzepte
    - Wechselwirkungen zwischen Wandlern, passiven Komponenten und Schutzvorrichtungen
    - Microgrid-Modellierung, Optimierung und Stabilitätsanalyse.
  • Hands-on Laborfähigkeiten mit einem proaktiven, selbstgesteuerten Ansatz zum Entwerfen, Bauen und Testen von Konvertersystemen und Schutzsystemen. Vielseitige Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, Theorie und Praxis über mehrere technische Domänen hinweg zu verbinden.
  • Fähigkeit, in einer schnelllebigen industriellen Forschungsumgebung zu gedeihen und Ergebnisse zu liefern.
  • Exzellente Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Englisch, sowohl schriftlich als auch verbal.

Mehr über uns

Im ABB Research Center in Baden-Dättwil in der Nähe von Zürich arbeiten wir an spannenden Technologien, die die Zukunft unserer Produkte prägen. Unsere internationalen Forschungsteams konzentrieren sich auf Leistungselektronik, Energiespeicherung, intelligente Systeme und Schalttechnik.

Wir freuen uns auf Ihre Bewerbung.

Chez ABB, nous aidons les industries à dépasser - plus maigre et plus propre. Ici, le progrès est une attente - pour vous, votre équipe, et le monde. En tant que leader mondial du marché, nous vous donnerons ce dont vous avez besoin pour que cela se produise. Il n'a pas toujours été facile, la croissance prend du grain. Mais à ABB, vous ne fuirez jamais seul. Exécutez ce qui tourne le monde.

Ce poste relève de:

Research Team Manager - Power Electronic Systems


Votre rôle et vos responsabilités


Êtes-vous passionné par la possibilité d'un avenir durable grâce à des systèmes de distribution basés sur des convertisseurs de puissance? Nous voulons avoir de tes nouvelles ! Une équipe internationale dynamique est heureuse de vous accueillir comme nouveau membre. Ensemble, nous allons repousser les frontières et avoir un impact durable sur la transition énergétique.

Le modèle de travail pour le rôle est : #LI-Hybrid

Les principales responsabilités comprennent

  • Pioneer concepts novateurs dans les systèmes de distribution à basse tension et à moyenne tension, en courant alternatif et en courant continu.
  • Effectuer des simulations détaillées, développer des algorithmes et des expériences en laboratoire, et publier les résultats de la recherche et les solutions novatrices en matière de brevets. Les résultats de l'enquête sont présentés dans le tableau ci-dessous. Collaborer avec des équipes mondiales multidisciplinaires de scientifiques à la recherche ABB.
  • Collaborer étroitement avec les unités opérationnelles d'ABB à la recherche de transition sur les applications réelles, y compris les centres de données, l'intégration des énergies renouvelables, l'électrification industrielle, l'extraction électronique et les systèmes marins.

• Qualifications pour le rôle

  • PhD en génie électrique avec spécialisation en électronique de puissance, systèmes de puissance ou contrôle.
  • L'excellence de la recherche éprouvée a été démontrée par des publications et des brevets à fort impact.
    • Topologies de convertisseur électronique de puissance, concepts de modulation et de commande
    - Interactions entre les convertisseurs, les composants passifs et les dispositifs de protection
    - Modélisation, optimisation et analyse de stabilité des microréseaux.
  • Compétences pratiques en laboratoire grâce à une approche proactive et autonome de la conception, de la construction et de l'essai de systèmes de convertisseurs et de systèmes de protection. Compétences polyvalentes avec la capacité de relier la théorie et la pratique dans plusieurs domaines techniques.
  • Capacité de prospérer dans un environnement de recherche industrielle rapide et d'obtenir des résultats.
  • Excellentes compétences en communication en anglais, à la fois écrite et verbale.

En savoir plus sur nous

Au centre de recherche ABB de Baden-Dättwil à proximité de Zurich, nous travaillons sur des technologies passionnantes qui façonnent l'avenir de nos produits. Nos équipes de recherche internationales se concentrent sur l'électronique électrique, le stockage de l'énergie, les systèmes intelligents et le commutateur.

Nous avons hâte de recevoir votre demande.

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Chapter Leader (Control Firmware)


Your Role and • Responsibilities

In this role, you will have the opportunity to contribute to ABB’s success with technology, software, product, and system development. Each day, you will identify and implement innovative solutions to relevant problems. You will also showcase your expertise by providing ideas and by being able to work both independently and as a part of a Research & Development (R&D) team.

Work model: #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Firmware Development: Design, develop, and implement firmware for Power Electronic Converters and communication modules, ensuring robust functionality and cybersecurity.

  • Software Quality Assurance: Conduct unit, integration, and system testing to validate software performance and reliability.

  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with system architects and hardware/software engineers to translate system requirements into detailed firmware specifications.

  • Innovation and Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to intellectual property creation and collaborate with global engineering teams to drive continuous improvement and share expertise.

• Qualifications for the Role

  • You are highly skilled in C/C++/Python/assembler backed by solid computer science fundamentals.

  • You have solid knowledge in structured development processes, ranging from requirement analysis, design, and implementation to test and documentation.

  • You have at least 5 years of experience in designing control firmware based on microcontrollers / DSPs for Power Electronic Products such as UPS, BESS, Renewable Energy systems.

  • Possess an enhanced knowledge of development infrastructure: Azure DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, version control systems (git), lifecycle management, build systems, unit testing, debug probes, oscilloscopes, and similar tools.

  • Exposure to Cyber Security concepts and knowledge of main industrial communication protocols (Modbus, Ethernet/IP, IEC61850, Profibus, CAN bus) are a plus.

  • You are passionate about team working and innovation.

  • M.Sc. or B.Sc. degree in Information or Electrical, Power Electronic, Electronic Engineering, Embedded Systems, or comparable field

  • You are at ease communicating in English and Italian

More about us

ABB Smart Power provides energy distribution solutions for data centers, industrial and manufacturing plants, critical infrastructure and commercial buildings. The Division’s technical teams work closely with industry partners, delivering advanced solutions that support rapid growth, energy transition, and sustainability objectives. The Division’s portfolio includes industrial circuit breakers, low-voltage systems, motor starting applications, and safety devices like switches and relays. Its Power Protection unit supports the world’s largest data center companies with advanced energy-efficient UPS solutions. The Division’s ABB Ability™ Energy Manager provides a scalable, easy-to-use platform that helps organizations save energy and reduce CO2 emissions.

Join us. Be part of the team where progress happens, industries transform, and your work shapes the world.
Run What Runs the World.

#ABBCareers #RunwithABB

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.

Chapitre Leader (Control Firmware)

jobs.description:
At ABB, we help industries outrun - leaner and cleaner. Here, progress is an expectation - for you, your team, and the world. As a global market leader, we’ll give you what you need to make it happen. It won’t always be easy, growing takes grit. But at ABB, you’ll never run alone. Run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Production Engineering Manager


Your role and responsibilities (Mandatory)

In this position, you will provide assistance in testing and verification activities on a range of assignments in the UPS products of ABB Smart Power in Quartino. You will be in charge of the testing and verification activities for low- and medium-complexity systems, subsystems, or products.

The work model for the role is hybrid. #LI-Hybrid

You will be mainly accountable for:

  • Defining the troubleshooting procedure and troubleshooting level two, in case a new event occurs not covered by the troubleshooting procedure.

  • Maintaining, changing, and optimizing test instructions for mass production in consultancy with the R&D Engineer (Center of Excellence).

  • Providing technical support during the installation of test objects in the test area.

  • Assisting the Production Supervisor in defining and maintaining the skill matrix for test operators.


• Qualifications for the role

  • At least 3 years of experience in UPS, working as a service technician, or in engineering, testing, etc.

  • Sound knowledge of engineering techniques, processes, and tools, including measurement with a power meter, oscilloscope, etc.

  • A strong focus on safe work practices and dedication to following workplace safety guidelines.

  • A high level of self-motivation, curiosity, and desire to learn about new technologies.

  • A collaborative, solution-focused approach, and strong written and spoken communication skills.

  • A degree in electrical/electronic or similar field · Fluent in English


More about us


ABB Smart Power is a global technology leader, with products and solutions that make power supplies smart, connected, and protected. Its intelligent products and solutions make power more competitive by improving the energy efficiency, productivity, and reliability of almost any operation.

We value people from different backgrounds. Could this be your story? Apply today or visit www.abb.com to read more about us and learn about the impact of our solutions across the globe.
